## ===== campaign/fills/c1/evidence/c1-nf-cont1/probe/probe-run.log =====

@guessCtlRunTM : {k : ℕ} →
  {SP SQ Q : Type} →
    [DecidableEq SP] →
      [DecidableEq SQ] →
        MultiTapeTM k Bool SP →
          SP →
            Fin k →
              Q →
                (Q → Bool → Q) →
                  (Q → Bool) →
                    Bool →
                      MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ →
                        SQ → SQ → SQ → NDTM k Bool ((i : GuessRunPhase) × GuessRunPhase.CtlState SP SQ Q i)
GuessRunPhase.CtlState : Type → Type → Type → GuessRunPhase → Type
GuessRunPhase.ctlState_pre : ∀ (SP SQ Q : Type), GuessRunPhase.CtlState SP SQ Q GuessRunPhase.pre = SP
GuessRunPhase.ctlState_guess : ∀ (SP SQ Q : Type), GuessRunPhase.CtlState SP SQ Q GuessRunPhase.guess = NDWriterState Q
GuessRunPhase.ctlState_skip : ∀ (SP SQ Q : Type), GuessRunPhase.CtlState SP SQ Q GuessRunPhase.skip = SeekPhase
GuessRunPhase.ctlState_back : ∀ (SP SQ Q : Type), GuessRunPhase.CtlState SP SQ Q GuessRunPhase.back = SeekPhase
GuessRunPhase.ctlState_run : ∀ (SP SQ Q : Type), GuessRunPhase.CtlState SP SQ Q GuessRunPhase.run = SQ
GuessRunPhase.ctlState_out : ∀ (SP SQ Q : Type), GuessRunPhase.CtlState SP SQ Q GuessRunPhase.out = Bool
@guessCtlRunPhases : {k : ℕ} →
  {SP SQ Q : Type} →
    MultiTapeTM k Bool SP →
      Fin k →
        Q →
          (Q → Bool → Q) →
            (Q → Bool) →
              Bool → MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ → (i : GuessRunPhase) → NDTM k Bool (GuessRunPhase.CtlState SP SQ Q i)
@guessCtlRunPhases_pre : ∀ {k : ℕ} {SP SQ Q : Type} (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (j : Fin k) (q₀ : Q) (δ : Q → Bool → Q)
  (stop : Q → Bool) (bounded : Bool) (V : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ),
  guessCtlRunPhases P j q₀ δ stop bounded V GuessRunPhase.pre = P.toNDTM
@guessCtlRunPhases_guess : ∀ {k : ℕ} {SP SQ Q : Type} (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (j : Fin k) (q₀ : Q)
  (δ : Q → Bool → Q) (stop : Q → Bool) (bounded : Bool) (V : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ),
  guessCtlRunPhases P j q₀ δ stop bounded V GuessRunPhase.guess = ndWriterTM k j q₀ δ stop bounded
@guessCtlRunPhases_skip : ∀ {k : ℕ} {SP SQ Q : Type} (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (j : Fin k) (q₀ : Q) (δ : Q → Bool → Q)
  (stop : Q → Bool) (bounded : Bool) (V : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ),
  guessCtlRunPhases P j q₀ δ stop bounded V GuessRunPhase.skip = (skipTM k j).toNDTM
@guessCtlRunPhases_back : ∀ {k : ℕ} {SP SQ Q : Type} (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (j : Fin k) (q₀ : Q) (δ : Q → Bool → Q)
  (stop : Q → Bool) (bounded : Bool) (V : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ),
  guessCtlRunPhases P j q₀ δ stop bounded V GuessRunPhase.back = (skipBackTM k j).toNDTM
@guessCtlRunPhases_run : ∀ {k : ℕ} {SP SQ Q : Type} (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (j : Fin k) (q₀ : Q) (δ : Q → Bool → Q)
  (stop : Q → Bool) (bounded : Bool) (V : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ),
  guessCtlRunPhases P j q₀ δ stop bounded V GuessRunPhase.run = V.toNDTM
@guessCtlRunPhases_out : ∀ {k : ℕ} {SP SQ Q : Type} (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (j : Fin k) (q₀ : Q) (δ : Q → Bool → Q)
  (stop : Q → Bool) (bounded : Bool) (V : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ),
  guessCtlRunPhases P j q₀ δ stop bounded V GuessRunPhase.out =
    { q₀ := false,
      tr := fun x b x_1 x_2 => { inputTape := 0, workTapes := fun x => (none, 0), output := some b, state := none } }
@guessCtlRunRed : {SP SQ Q : Type} →
  [DecidableEq SP] →
    [DecidableEq SQ] →
      SP →
        Q →
          SQ →
            SQ →
              SQ →
                (i : GuessRunPhase) →
                  GuessRunPhase.CtlState SP SQ Q i → Option ((i : GuessRunPhase) × GuessRunPhase.CtlState SP SQ Q i)
@guessCtlRunRed_pre : ∀ {SP SQ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ] (pexit : SP) (q₀ : Q)
  (qentry acc rej : SQ) (s : SP),
  guessCtlRunRed pexit q₀ qentry acc rej GuessRunPhase.pre s =
    if s = pexit then some ⟨GuessRunPhase.guess, NDWriterState.run q₀⟩ else none
@guessCtlRunRed_guess_done : ∀ {SP SQ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ] (pexit : SP) (q₀ : Q)
  (qentry acc rej : SQ),
  guessCtlRunRed pexit q₀ qentry acc rej GuessRunPhase.guess NDWriterState.done =
    some ⟨GuessRunPhase.skip, SeekPhase.run⟩
@guessCtlRunRed_guess_run : ∀ {SP SQ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ] (pexit : SP) (q₀ : Q)
  (qentry acc rej : SQ) (q : Q), guessCtlRunRed pexit q₀ qentry acc rej GuessRunPhase.guess (NDWriterState.run q) = none
@guessCtlRunRed_skip : ∀ {SP SQ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ] (pexit : SP) (q₀ : Q)
  (qentry acc rej : SQ) (s : SeekPhase),
  guessCtlRunRed pexit q₀ qentry acc rej GuessRunPhase.skip s =
    if s = SeekPhase.done then some ⟨GuessRunPhase.back, SeekPhase.run⟩ else none
@guessCtlRunRed_back : ∀ {SP SQ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ] (pexit : SP) (q₀ : Q)
  (qentry acc rej : SQ) (s : SeekPhase),
  guessCtlRunRed pexit q₀ qentry acc rej GuessRunPhase.back s =
    if s = SeekPhase.done then some ⟨GuessRunPhase.run, qentry⟩ else none
@guessCtlRunRed_run : ∀ {SP SQ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ] (pexit : SP) (q₀ : Q)
  (qentry acc rej s : SQ),
  guessCtlRunRed pexit q₀ qentry acc rej GuessRunPhase.run s =
    if s = acc then some ⟨GuessRunPhase.out, true⟩ else if s = rej then some ⟨GuessRunPhase.out, false⟩ else none
@guessCtlRunRed_out : ∀ {SP SQ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ] (pexit : SP) (q₀ : Q)
  (qentry acc rej : SQ) (b : Bool), guessCtlRunRed pexit q₀ qentry acc rej GuessRunPhase.out b = none
@guessRunCfg : {k : ℕ} → {S S' : Type} → {z : List Bool} → Cfg k Bool S z → Fin k → List Bool → S' → Cfg k Bool S' z
@guessRunCfg_clean : ∀ {K k : ℕ} {SP SR : Type} {z : List Bool} (ι : Fin K ↪ Fin k),
  ∀ cap ∉ Set.range ⇑ι,
    ∀ (jR : Fin K) (blk : ℤ → Option Bool) (m : ℕ),
      (∀ (p : ℤ), p < 0 ∨ ↑m ≤ p → blk p = none) →
        ∀ (q : SP) (entry : SR) (s : List Bool),
          s.length = m →
            guessRunCfg
                { state := some q, inputPos := 1, workTapes := Function.update (fun x x_1 => none) (ι jR) blk,
                  workTapePos := fun x => 0, output := [] }
                (ι jR) s entry =
              embedSilentCfg ι cap (fun x x_1 => none) (fun x => 0) [] [] (streamStartCfg z jR entry s)
@streamStartCfg : {K : ℕ} → {S : Type} → (z : List Bool) → Fin K → S → List Bool → Cfg K Bool S z
@guessCtlRunTM_runWith_handoff : ∀ {k : ℕ} {SP SQ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ]
  (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (pexit : SP) (j : Fin k) (q₀ : Q) (δ : Q → Bool → Q) (stop : Q → Bool)
  (V : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ) (qentry acc rej : SQ) {z : List Bool} (TP : ℕ) (cP : Cfg k Bool SP z),
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (MultiTapeTM.initCfg z) TP = cP →
    cP.state = some pexit →
      (∀ u < TP, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (MultiTapeTM.initCfg z) u).state ≠ some pexit) →
        (∀ (p : ℕ), cP.workTapes j (cP.workTapePos j + ↑p) = none) →
          cP.workTapes j (cP.workTapePos j - 1) = none →
            ∀ (m : ℕ) (w : List Bool),
              w.length = TP + 2 * m + 9 →
                (∀ i < m, stop (List.foldl δ q₀ (List.take i (List.drop (TP + 1) w))) = false) →
                  stop (List.foldl δ q₀ (List.take m (List.drop (TP + 1) w))) = true →
                    NDTM.runWith w (NDTM.initCfg z) =
                      Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk GuessRunPhase.run)
                        (guessRunCfg cP j (List.take m (List.drop (TP + 1) w)) qentry)
@guessCtlRunTM_runWith : ∀ {k : ℕ} {SP SQ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ]
  (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (pexit : SP) (j : Fin k) (q₀ : Q) (δ : Q → Bool → Q) (stop : Q → Bool)
  (V : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ) (qentry acc rej : SQ) {z : List Bool} (TP : ℕ) (cP : Cfg k Bool SP z),
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (MultiTapeTM.initCfg z) TP = cP →
    cP.state = some pexit →
      (∀ u < TP, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (MultiTapeTM.initCfg z) u).state ≠ some pexit) →
        (∀ (p : ℕ), cP.workTapes j (cP.workTapePos j + ↑p) = none) →
          cP.workTapes j (cP.workTapePos j - 1) = none →
            ∀ (m : ℕ) (s : List Bool),
              s.length = m →
                (∀ i < m, stop (List.foldl δ q₀ (List.take i s)) = false) →
                  stop (List.foldl δ q₀ s) = true →
                    ∀ (TQ : ℕ),
                      (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) TQ).state = some acc ∨
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) TQ).state = some rej →
                        (∀ u < TQ,
                            (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) u).state ≠ some acc ∧
                              (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) u).state ≠ some rej) →
                          ∀ (w : List Bool),
                            List.take m (List.drop (TP + 1) w) = s →
                              TP + 2 * m + TQ + 11 ≤ w.length →
                                have d := MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) TQ;
                                NDTM.runWith w (NDTM.initCfg z) =
                                  { state := none, inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
                                    workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output ++ [decide (d.state = some acc)] }
@guessCtlRunTM_stop_of_halted : ∀ {k : ℕ} {SP SQ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ]
  (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (pexit : SP) (j : Fin k) (q₀ : Q) (δ : Q → Bool → Q) (stop : Q → Bool)
  (V : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ) (qentry acc rej : SQ) {z : List Bool} (TP : ℕ) (cP : Cfg k Bool SP z),
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (MultiTapeTM.initCfg z) TP = cP →
    cP.state = some pexit →
      (∀ u < TP, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (MultiTapeTM.initCfg z) u).state ≠ some pexit) →
        ∀ (w : List Bool),
          (NDTM.runWith w (NDTM.initCfg z)).state = none →
            ∃ m,
              TP + 1 + m < w.length ∧
                (∀ i < m, stop (List.foldl δ q₀ (List.take i (List.drop (TP + 1) w))) = false) ∧
                  stop (List.foldl δ q₀ (List.take m (List.drop (TP + 1) w))) = true
@guessCtlRunTM_accepts_of : ∀ {k : ℕ} {SP SQ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ]
  (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (pexit : SP) (j : Fin k) (q₀ : Q) (δ : Q → Bool → Q) (stop : Q → Bool)
  (V : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ) (qentry acc rej : SQ) {z : List Bool} (TP : ℕ) (cP : Cfg k Bool SP z),
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (MultiTapeTM.initCfg z) TP = cP →
    cP.state = some pexit →
      (∀ u < TP, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (MultiTapeTM.initCfg z) u).state ≠ some pexit) →
        (∀ (p : ℕ), cP.workTapes j (cP.workTapePos j + ↑p) = none) →
          cP.workTapes j (cP.workTapePos j - 1) = none →
            ∀ (s : List Bool),
              (∀ i < s.length, stop (List.foldl δ q₀ (List.take i s)) = false) →
                stop (List.foldl δ q₀ s) = true →
                  ∀ (TQ : ℕ),
                    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) TQ).state = some acc →
                      (∀ u < TQ,
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) u).state ≠ some acc ∧
                            (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) u).state ≠ some rej) →
                        (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) TQ).output = [] →
                          ∀ (B : ℕ),
                            TP + 2 * s.length + TQ + 11 ≤ B →
                              ∃ w,
                                w.length = B ∧
                                  (NDTM.runWith w (NDTM.initCfg z)).state = none ∧
                                    (NDTM.runWith w (NDTM.initCfg z)).output = [true]
@guessCtlRunTM_stream_of_accepts : ∀ {k : ℕ} {SP SQ Q : Type} [inst : DecidableEq SP] [inst_1 : DecidableEq SQ]
  (P : MultiTapeTM k Bool SP) (pexit : SP) (j : Fin k) (q₀ : Q) (δ : Q → Bool → Q) (stop : Q → Bool)
  (V : MultiTapeTM k Bool SQ) (qentry acc rej : SQ) {z : List Bool} (TP : ℕ) (cP : Cfg k Bool SP z),
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (MultiTapeTM.initCfg z) TP = cP →
    cP.state = some pexit →
      (∀ u < TP, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (MultiTapeTM.initCfg z) u).state ≠ some pexit) →
        (∀ (p : ℕ), cP.workTapes j (cP.workTapePos j + ↑p) = none) →
          cP.workTapes j (cP.workTapePos j - 1) = none →
            (∀ (s : List Bool),
                (∀ i < s.length, stop (List.foldl δ q₀ (List.take i s)) = false) →
                  stop (List.foldl δ q₀ s) = true →
                    ∃ TQ,
                      ((MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) TQ).state = some acc ∨
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) TQ).state = some rej) ∧
                        ∀ u < TQ,
                          (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) u).state ≠ some acc ∧
                            (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) u).state ≠ some rej) →
              ∀ (w : List Bool),
                (NDTM.runWith w (NDTM.initCfg z)).state = none →
                  (NDTM.runWith w (NDTM.initCfg z)).output = [true] →
                    ∃ s,
                      (∀ i < s.length, stop (List.foldl δ q₀ (List.take i s)) = false) ∧
                        stop (List.foldl δ q₀ s) = true ∧
                          ∃ TQ,
                            (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) TQ).state = some acc ∧
                              (∀ u < TQ,
                                  (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) u).state ≠ some acc ∧
                                    (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) u).state ≠ some rej) ∧
                                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom (guessRunCfg cP j s qentry) TQ).output = []
NDWriterState : Type → Type
ndWriterTM : (k : ℕ) → Fin k → {Q : Type} → Q → (Q → Bool → Q) → (Q → Bool) → Bool → NDTM k Bool (NDWriterState Q)
@ndWriterTM_run_controller : ∀ {k : ℕ} (j : Fin k) {Q : Type} (q₀ : Q) (δ : Q → Bool → Q) (stop : Q → Bool)
  {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool (NDWriterState Q) x) (q : Q),
  c.state = some (NDWriterState.run q) →
    ∀ (w : List Bool),
      ∀ m < w.length,
        (∀ i < m, stop (List.foldl δ q (List.take i w)) = false) →
          stop (List.foldl δ q (List.take m w)) = true →
            NDTM.runWith (List.take (m + 1) w) c =
                { state := some NDWriterState.done, inputPos := c.inputPos,
                  workTapes :=
                    Function.update c.workTapes j fun p =>
                      if c.workTapePos j ≤ p ∧ p < c.workTapePos j + ↑m then
                        FinTM.bufferTape (List.take m w) (p - c.workTapePos j)
                      else c.workTapes j p,
                  workTapePos := Function.update c.workTapePos j (c.workTapePos j + ↑m), output := c.output } ∧
              ∀ i ≤ m, (NDTM.runWith (List.take i w) c).state ≠ some NDWriterState.done
@NDTM.phaseHostND : {k : ℕ} →
  {Γ I : Type} →
    {Ph : I → Type} →
      ((i : I) → NDTM k Γ (Ph i)) →
        (i : I) × Ph i → ((i : I) → Ph i → Option ((i : I) × Ph i)) → NDTM k Γ ((i : I) × Ph i)
@NDTM.phaseHostND_run : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → NDTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : (i : I) × Ph i)
  (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option ((i : I) × Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ} (c c' : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (w : List Bool),
  NDTM.runWith w c = c' →
    ∀ (s' : Ph i),
      c'.state = some s' →
        ∀ (q' : (i : I) × Ph i),
          red i s' = some q' →
            (∀ u < w.length, ∀ (s : Ph i), (NDTM.runWith (List.take u w) c).state = some s → red i s = none) →
              ∀ (b : Bool),
                (∀ u ≤ w.length,
                    NDTM.runWith (List.take u w) (Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) c) =
                      Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) (NDTM.runWith (List.take u w) c)) ∧
                  NDTM.runWith (w ++ [b]) (Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) c) = Cfg.mapState (fun x => q') c'
@phaseHostTM : {k : ℕ} →
  {Γ I : Type} →
    {Ph : I → Type} →
      ((i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) →
        (i : I) × Ph i → ((i : I) → Ph i → Option ((i : I) × Ph i)) → MultiTapeTM k Γ ((i : I) × Ph i)
@phaseHostTM_q₀ : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : (i : I) × Ph i)
  (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option ((i : I) × Ph i)), (phaseHostTM M q0 red).q₀ = q0
@phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_none : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i))
  (q0 : (i : I) × Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option ((i : I) × Ph i)) (i : I) (s : Ph i),
  red i s = none →
    ∀ (inp : Option Γ) (w : Fin k → Option Γ),
      (phaseHostTM M q0 red).tr ⟨i, s⟩ inp w = Action.mapState (Sigma.mk i) ((M i).tr s inp w)
@phaseHostTM_tr_of_red_some : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i))
  (q0 : (i : I) × Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option ((i : I) × Ph i)) (i : I) (s : Ph i) {q' : (i : I) × Ph i},
  red i s = some q' →
    ∀ (inp : Option Γ) (w : Fin k → Option Γ),
      (phaseHostTM M q0 red).tr ⟨i, s⟩ inp w =
        { inputTape := 0, workTapes := fun x => (none, 0), output := none, state := some q' }
@phaseHostTM_run : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i)) (q0 : (i : I) × Ph i)
  (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option ((i : I) × Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ} (c c' : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x) (T : ℕ),
  MultiTapeTM.runFrom c T = c' →
    ∀ (s' : Ph i),
      c'.state = some s' →
        ∀ (q' : (i : I) × Ph i),
          red i s' = some q' →
            (∀ u < T, ∀ (s : Ph i), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u).state = some s → red i s = none) →
              (∀ u ≤ T,
                  MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) c) u =
                    Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u)) ∧
                MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) c) (T + 1) = Cfg.mapState (fun x => q') c'
@phaseHostTM_run_le : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ I : Type} {Ph : I → Type} (M : (i : I) → MultiTapeTM k Γ (Ph i))
  (q0 : (i : I) × Ph i) (red : (i : I) → Ph i → Option ((i : I) × Ph i)) (i : I) {x : List Γ} (c : Cfg k Γ (Ph i) x)
  (T : ℕ),
  (∀ u < T, ∀ (s : Ph i), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u).state = some s → red i s = none) →
    ∀ u ≤ T, MultiTapeTM.runFrom (Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) c) u = Cfg.mapState (Sigma.mk i) (MultiTapeTM.runFrom c u)
@skipTM : {Symbol : Type u_1} → (k : ℕ) → Fin k → MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase
@skipBackTM : {Symbol : Type u_1} → (k : ℕ) → Fin k → MultiTapeTM k Symbol SeekPhase
@skipTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x),
  d.state = some SeekPhase.run →
    (∀ (p : ℤ), 0 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (w.length + 1) =
          { state := some SeekPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
            workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i + ↑w.length + 1), output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < w.length + 1, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SeekPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ w.length + 1,
              if j = i then
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length + 1)
              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@skipBackTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (u : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol SeekPhase x),
  d.state = some SeekPhase.run →
    (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑u.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i - ↑u.length - 1 + p) = FinTM.bufferTape u p) →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (u.length + 3) =
          { state := some SeekPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos, workTapes := d.workTapes,
            workTapePos := Function.update d.workTapePos i (d.workTapePos i - ↑u.length - 1), output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < u.length + 3, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SeekPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ u.length + 3,
              if j = i then
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - ↑u.length - 2) (d.workTapePos j)
              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
inputRewindTM : (k : ℕ) → MultiTapeTM k Bool InputRewindPhase
@inputRewindTM_run : ∀ {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg k Bool InputRewindPhase x),
  d.state = some InputRewindPhase.start →
    1 ≤ ↑d.inputPos →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (↑d.inputPos + 1) =
          { state := some InputRewindPhase.done, inputPos := 1, workTapes := d.workTapes, workTapePos := d.workTapePos,
            output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < ↑d.inputPos + 1, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some InputRewindPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ t ≤ ↑d.inputPos + 1,
            (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
              (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧ (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).output = d.output
@inputRewindTM_step_done : ∀ {k : ℕ} {x : List Bool} (c : Cfg k Bool InputRewindPhase x),
  c.state = some InputRewindPhase.done → MultiTapeTM.step c = c
StepBlock.outputSummary : List Bool → Option Bool
StepBlock.summaryEmit : Option Bool → Option Bool → Option Bool
StepBlock.outputSummary_nil : StepBlock.outputSummary [] = none
StepBlock.outputSummary_append : ∀ (w : List Bool) (b : Option Bool),
  StepBlock.outputSummary (w ++ b.toList) = StepBlock.summaryEmit (StepBlock.outputSummary w) b
StepBlock.outputSummary_true : ∀ (w : List Bool), StepBlock.outputSummary w = some true ↔ w = [true]
StepBlock.summaryEmit_other : ∀ (b : Option Bool), StepBlock.summaryEmit (some false) b = some false
StepBlock.summaryEmit_none : ∀ (b : Option Bool), StepBlock.summaryEmit none b = b
@NDTM.relabelState : {k : ℕ} → {Γ : Type u_1} → {S : Type u_2} → {S' : Type u_3} → NDTM k Γ S → S ≃ S' → NDTM k Γ S'
@NDTM.relabelState_runWith : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {S' : Type u_3} {x : List Γ} (tm : NDTM k Γ S)
  (e : S ≃ S') (c : Cfg k Γ S x) (w : List Bool),
  NDTM.runWith w (Cfg.mapState (⇑e) c) = Cfg.mapState (⇑e) (NDTM.runWith w c)
@NDTM.relabelState_q₀ : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {S' : Type u_3} (tm : NDTM k Γ S) (e : S ≃ S'),
  (tm.relabelState e).q₀ = e tm.q₀
@NDTM.relabelState_tr : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {S' : Type u_3} (tm : NDTM k Γ S) (e : S ≃ S')
  (b : Bool) (q : S') (inp : Option Γ) (w : Fin k → Option Γ),
  (tm.relabelState e).tr b q inp w = Action.mapState (⇑e) (tm.tr b (e.symm q) inp w)
@NDTM.runWith_nil : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol} {tm : NDTM k Symbol State}
  {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input}, NDTM.runWith [] cfg = cfg
@NDTM.runWith_cons : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol} {tm : NDTM k Symbol State}
  {b : Bool} {w : List Bool} {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input},
  NDTM.runWith (b :: w) cfg = NDTM.runWith w (NDTM.stepWith b cfg)
@NDTM.runWith_append : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol} {tm : NDTM k Symbol State}
  (w w' : List Bool) (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input), NDTM.runWith (w ++ w') cfg = NDTM.runWith w' (NDTM.runWith w cfg)
@NDTM.runWith_of_halt : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol}
  {tm : NDTM k Symbol State} (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input),
  cfg.state = none → ∀ {w : List Bool}, NDTM.runWith w cfg = cfg
@NDTM.initCfg_eq : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {tm : NDTM k Symbol State} (input : List Symbol),
  NDTM.initCfg input = Cfg.init tm.q₀ input
@MultiTapeTM.toNDTM_initCfg : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
  (input : List Symbol), NDTM.initCfg input = MultiTapeTM.initCfg input
@MultiTapeTM.toNDTM_runWith : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} (tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State)
  {input : List Symbol} (w : List Bool) (cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input),
  NDTM.runWith w cfg = MultiTapeTM.runFrom cfg w.length
@NDTM.runWith_mapState_of_agreeOn : ∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} {H : Type u_3} {x : List Γ}
  (src : NDTM k Γ S) (host : NDTM k Γ H) (emb : S ↪ H) (good : S → Prop),
  (∀ (b : Bool) (q : S),
      good q →
        ∀ (inp : Option Γ) (work : Fin k → Option Γ),
          host.tr b (emb q) inp work = Action.mapState (⇑emb) (src.tr b q inp work)) →
    ∀ (c : Cfg k Γ S x) (w : List Bool),
      (∀ u < w.length, ∀ (q : S), (NDTM.runWith (List.take u w) c).state = some q → good q) →
        NDTM.runWith w (Cfg.mapState (⇑emb) c) = Cfg.mapState (⇑emb) (NDTM.runWith w c)
FinNDTM.AcceptsWithin : FinNDTM Bool → List Bool → ℕ → Prop
@FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff : ∀ {N : FinNDTM Bool} {x : List Bool} {t : ℕ},
  N.AcceptsWithin x t ↔
    ∃ w,
      w.length = t ∧ (NDTM.runWith w (NDTM.initCfg x)).state = none ∧ (NDTM.runWith w (NDTM.initCfg x)).output = [true]
CodeNDTM : Type
CodeNDTM.toFinNDTM : CodeNDTM → FinNDTM Bool
CodeNDTM.toFinNDTM_k : ∀ (M : CodeNDTM), M.toFinNDTM.k = 2
CodeNDTM.toFinNDTM_State : ∀ (M : CodeNDTM), M.toFinNDTM.State = Fin (M.numStates + 1)
CodeNDTM.toFinNDTM_tm : ∀ (M : CodeNDTM), M.toFinNDTM.tm = M.tm
@MultiTapeTM.step_of_some : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {input : List Symbol}
  {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State} {cfg : Cfg k Symbol State input} {q : State},
  cfg.state = some q → MultiTapeTM.step cfg = (tm.tr q cfg.inputSymbol cfg.workTapeSymbols).apply cfg
@MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} {tm : MultiTapeTM k Symbol State}
  (input : List Symbol), MultiTapeTM.initCfg input = Cfg.init tm.q₀ input
@Cfg.init_state : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} (q₀ : State) (input : List Symbol),
  (Cfg.init q₀ input).state = some q₀
@Cfg.init_inputPos : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} (q₀ : State) (input : List Symbol),
  (Cfg.init q₀ input).inputPos = 1
@Cfg.init_workTapes : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} (q₀ : State) (input : List Symbol) (x : Fin k)
  (x_1 : ℤ), (Cfg.init q₀ input).workTapes x x_1 = none
@Cfg.init_workTapePos : ∀ {k : ℕ} {State : Type u_1} {Symbol : Type u_2} (q₀ : State) (input : List Symbol) (x : Fin k),
  (Cfg.init q₀ input).workTapePos x = 0

  (guessRunCfg c j s q).state = some q

  (q : S'), (guessRunCfg c j s q).inputPos = c.inputPos

  (q : S') (a : Fin k) (a_1 : ℤ),
  (guessRunCfg c j s q).workTapes a a_1 =
    Function.update c.workTapes j
      (fun p =>
        if c.workTapePos j ≤ p ∧ p < c.workTapePos j + ↑s.length then FinTM.bufferTape s (p - c.workTapePos j)

  (∀ (q : S),

        ∀ (inp : Option Symbol) (work : Fin k → Option Symbol),
          host.tr (emb q) inp work = Action.mapState (⇑emb) (src.tr q inp work)) →

@scanTM : {Γ : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type} → (k : ℕ) → Fin k → (A → Γ → A × Γ) → (A → Γ → A × Γ) → A → MultiTapeTM k Γ (ScanPhase A)
ScanPhase : Type → Type
@scanTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Γ : Type u_1} {A : Type} {k : ℕ} {x : List Γ} (i : Fin k) (δf δb : A → Γ → A × Γ) (a₀ : A)
  (w : List Γ) (d : Cfg k Γ (ScanPhase A) x),
  d.state = some (ScanPhase.fwd a₀) →
    (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
          { state := some (ScanPhase.done (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).1), inputPos := d.inputPos,
            workTapes := fun j q =>
              if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then
                FinTM.bufferTape (scanResult δf δb a₀ w).2 (q - d.workTapePos j)
              else d.workTapes j q,
            workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, ∀ (a : A), (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some (ScanPhase.done a)) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
              if j = i then
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j
@scanFold : {A : Type u_1} → {Γ : Type u_2} → (A → Γ → A) → A → Γ → A × Γ
@scanKeep : {A : Type u_1} → {Γ : Type u_2} → A → Γ → A × Γ
@scanResult_fold : ∀ {A : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} (δ : A → Γ → A) (a₀ : A) (w : List Γ),
  scanResult (scanFold δ) scanKeep a₀ w = (List.foldl δ a₀ w, w)

@clearTM_run_ofCfg : ∀ {Symbol : Type u_1} {k : ℕ} {x : List Symbol} (i : Fin k) (w : List Symbol)
  (d : Cfg k Symbol SweepPhase x),
  d.state = some SweepPhase.sweep →
    (∀ (p : ℤ), -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ↑w.length → d.workTapes i (d.workTapePos i + p) = FinTM.bufferTape w p) →
      MultiTapeTM.runFrom d (2 * w.length + 2) =
          { state := some SweepPhase.done, inputPos := d.inputPos,
            workTapes := fun j q =>
              if j = i ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧ q < d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length then none else d.workTapes j q,
            workTapePos := d.workTapePos, output := d.output } ∧
        (∀ t < 2 * w.length + 2, (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).state ≠ some SweepPhase.done) ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin k),
            ∀ t ≤ 2 * w.length + 2,
              if j = i then
                (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j ∈ Finset.Icc (d.workTapePos j - 1) (d.workTapePos j + ↑w.length)
              else (MultiTapeTM.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = d.workTapePos j

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# dev.sh part1 [part2 ...] : splice parts after line 704 of the base module into scratch/NFDev.lean
# and check it with lean_check_tree.sh (one Lean process).
set -u
source ~/.elan/env
cd /home/user/tcslib
BASE=scratch/NDNormalForm.base.lean
OUT=scratch/NFDev.lean
{ head -n 704 "$BASE"; for p in "$@"; do cat "$p"; done; tail -n +705 "$BASE"; } > "$OUT"
/usr/bin/time -f "wall=%e maxrss_kb=%M" bash scripts/lean_check_tree.sh scratch/NFDev 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | head -${NLINES:-80}

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/evidence/c1-nf-cont1/runtime/finalize.py =====

```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""finalize.py <file>: region (c), the target's body, and region (d), the status phrases."""
import sys
p = sys.argv[1]; s = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()
old_body = """        M.toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t → ∃ t', N.AcceptsWithin x t') := by
  sorry
"""
new_body = """        M.toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t → ∃ t', N.AcceptsWithin x t') := by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := nf_pack (nf_host N)
  refine ⟨M, nf_C N.k, fun x t hN => (hM x _).2 (nf_forward N x t hN), fun x t hMt => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨w, -, hh, ho⟩ := (hM x t).1 hMt
  exact nf_backward_host N x w hh ho
"""
assert s.count(old_body) == 1
s = s.replace(old_body, new_body)
old1 = """* `Turing.FinNDTM.exists_codeNDTM_accepts_linear` — the linear-overhead coded normal form
  (statement; proof incomplete)."""
new1 = """* `Turing.FinNDTM.exists_codeNDTM_accepts_linear` — the linear-overhead coded normal form."""
assert s.count(old1) == 1; s = s.replace(old1, new1)
old2 = """cited through [AB09, §3.2]; statement; proof incomplete): every"""
new2 = """cited through [AB09, §3.2]): every"""
assert s.count(old2) == 1; s = s.replace(old2, new2)
open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s)
print("finalized")
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/evidence/c1-nf-cont1/runtime/inspect.py =====

```
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""inspect.py <module> <walk-ext.tsv> <out.md>: the inspection table of every rw/simp/simpa/dsimp/
unfold/show/change argument in the new region (the diff against the base)."""
import re, sys, subprocess
mod, ext, out = sys.argv[1:4]
base = subprocess.run(['git','show','HEAD:TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/NDNormalForm.lean'] if False else
                      ['cat','scratch/NDNormalForm.base.lean'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split('\n')
cur = open(mod).read().split('\n')
# new region: lines after 704 of the base, up to the target's docstring
start = 704; end = next(i for i,l in enumerate(cur) if l.startswith('/-- **The linear-overhead coded normal form**'))
tgt = next(i for i,l in enumerate(cur) if l.startswith('theorem exists_codeNDTM_accepts_linear'))
lines = list(enumerate(cur[start:end], start+1)) + list(enumerate(cur[tgt:], tgt+1))
kinds = {}
for l in open(ext):
    p = l.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
    if len(p) == 3: kinds[p[0]] = (p[1], p[2])
def classify(a):
    a0 = a.lstrip('←').strip()
    a0 = re.sub(r'^\(|\)$','',a0)
    head = a0.split()[0] if a0 else a0
    if head.startswith('nf_') or head.startswith('_root_') : return 'own (this file)'
    for cand in [head, 'Turing.'+head, 'Turing.FinNDTM.'+head, 'Turing.MultiTapeTM.'+head]:
        if cand in kinds:
            k, m = kinds[cand]
            src = 'TCSlib' if m.startswith('TCSlib') else ('core' if m.startswith(('Init','Std','Lean')) else 'Mathlib')
            return f'{src} {k} ({m})'
    if re.match(r'^[a-z][A-Za-z0-9_₀-₉\']*$', head) or head.startswith('h') : return 'local hypothesis/term'
    if re.match(r'^(List|Fin|Nat|Int|Option|SignType|Function|Bool)\.', head):
        return 'core/Mathlib lemma (applied definitionally by simp: no constant left in the term)'
    if head.startswith('show ') or head.startswith('(show'): return 'local proof term'
    return 'unresolved: ' + head
rows = []
pat = re.compile(r'\b(rw|rwa|simp only|simp|simpa only|simpa|dsimp only|dsimp|unfold|show|change|nth_rewrite|simp_all)\b(.*)')
segs = []
for n, l in lines:
    if l.strip().startswith('--'): continue
    for seg in re.split(r';\s+(?![^\[]*\])', l): segs.append((n, seg))
for n, l in segs:
    m = pat.search(l)
    if not m: continue
    tac, rest = m.group(1), m.group(2)
    if tac in ('show','change'):
        rows.append((n, tac, rest.strip()[:90], 'goal restatement (own statement form; no unfolding of other files)'))
        continue
    if tac == 'unfold':
        for a in rest.split():
            if a.startswith('at'): break
            rows.append((n, tac, a, classify(a)))
        continue
    br = re.search(r'\[(.*)\]', rest) if '[' in rest else None
    if br is None:
        rows.append((n, tac, '(no arguments)', 'default simp set / closing'))
        continue
    args = [a.strip() for a in re.split(r',(?![^()]*\))', br.group(1)) if a.strip()]
    for a in args: rows.append((n, tac, a, classify(a)))
with open(out,'w') as f:
    f.write('| line | tactic | argument | origin |\n|---|---|---|---|\n')
    for r in rows: f.write('| %d | `%s` | `%s` | %s |\n' % (r[0], r[1], r[2].replace('|','\\|'), r[3]))
print(len(rows), 'rows;', sum(1 for r in rows if r[3].startswith('unresolved')), 'unresolved')
```

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# mkzip.sh <zipname> <verifydir> <report.md> [extra evidence dirs...]
set -u
cd /home/user/tcslib
ZN="$1"; VD="$2"; REP="$3"; shift 3
BASE=348781a383f102d971fca153c818026b4f49fbf6
ST=$(mktemp -d /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/e83f8996-d545-513c-8228-08a794edf16c/scratchpad/zip.XXXX)
R="$ST/${ZN%.zip}"; mkdir -p "$R"/{source/TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP,patches,bundle,evidence/logs,evidence/checks,evidence/seal,evidence/probe,evidence/runtime}
cp "$REP" "$R/REPORT.md"
cp TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/NDNormalForm.lean "$R/source/TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/"
git format-patch -q -o "$R/patches" $BASE..HEAD
git bundle create -q "$R/bundle/fill-c1-nf-cont1.bundle" $BASE..fill/c1-nf-cont1
git bundle list-heads "$R/bundle/fill-c1-nf-cont1.bundle" > "$R/bundle/heads.txt"
git bundle verify "$R/bundle/fill-c1-nf-cont1.bundle" > "$R/bundle/verify.txt" 2>&1
for f in evidence/logs/*; do skip=0; for pat in ${EXCL:-}; do case "$(basename "$f")" in $pat) skip=1 ;; esac; done; [ $skip = 0 ] && cp "$f" "$R/evidence/logs/"; done
for f in tail.log tail-summary.tsv walk-raw.log walk-ext.tsv walk-new.txt new-decls.txt axioms-raw.log inspection.md \
         lint-campaign.txt lint-style.txt size.txt rule11.txt reached-defs.txt; do
  [ -f "$VD/$f" ] && cp "$VD/$f" "$R/evidence/checks/"; done
cp scratch/NFAxioms.lean "$R/evidence/checks/NFAxioms.lean"; cp scratch/NFWalk.lean "$R/evidence/checks/NFWalk.lean"
for f in NFSeal.lean seal-block.lean seal-set.txt seal-module.log NFSealCtl_unsealed.lean NFSealCtl_sealed.lean \
         controls-unsealed.log controls-sealed.log; do [ -f "$VD/$f" ] && cp "$VD/$f" "$R/evidence/seal/"; done
for f in NFProbeExt.lean probe-run.log probe-names.txt cited-names.txt probe-extra.txt; do
  [ -f "$VD/$f" ] && cp "$VD/$f" "$R/evidence/probe/"; done
for d in "$@"; do cp -r "$d" "$R/evidence/"; done
cp /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/e83f8996-d545-513c-8228-08a794edf16c/scratchpad/bin/*.sh /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/e83f8996-d545-513c-8228-08a794edf16c/scratchpad/bin/*.py "$R/evidence/runtime/"
cp scratch/walk.lean.txt "$R/evidence/runtime/"
( cd "$R" && find . -type f ! -name SHA256SUMS | sort | xargs sha256sum > SHA256SUMS )
mkdir -p /home/user/tcslib/deliveries
( cd "$ST" && rm -f "/home/user/tcslib/deliveries/$ZN" && zip -qr "/home/user/tcslib/deliveries/$ZN" "${ZN%.zip}" )
rm -rf "$ST"
ls -la "/home/user/tcslib/deliveries/$ZN"; sha256sum "/home/user/tcslib/deliveries/$ZN"

comm -23 "$OD/cited-names.txt" "$OD/probe-names.txt" > "$OD/probe-extra.txt"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# seal.sh <outdir> <reached-defs.txt> : sealed module copy + sealed/unsealed controls
set -u
source ~/.elan/env
cd /home/user/tcslib
OD="$1"; REACHED="$2"; mkdir -p "$OD"
MOD=TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/NDNormalForm.lean
# seal set: the review's 223 plus the reached TCSlib definitions that are not structure
# projections or casesOn recursors
grep -vE '\.(casesOn)$' "$REACHED" | grep -vE '^Turing\.(Action\.(inputTape|output|state|workTapes)|Cfg\.(inputPos|output|state|workTapePos|workTapes)|FinNDTM\.(State|decEqState|fintypeState|k|tm)|MultiTapeTM\.(q₀|tr)|NDTM\.(q₀|tr))$' \
  | cat - scratch/seal223.txt | sort -u > "$OD/seal-set.txt"
N=$(wc -l < "$OD/seal-set.txt")
{ echo "attribute [-simp] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg Turing.NDTM.initCfg"
  echo "attribute [local irreducible]"; sed 's/^/  /' "$OD/seal-set.txt"; } > "$OD/seal-block.lean"
# the sealed module copy: the block right before the first new private (after line 704)
{ head -n 704 "$MOD"; echo; echo "-- SEAL ($N definitions)"; cat "$OD/seal-block.lean"; tail -n +705 "$MOD"; } > scratch/NFSeal.lean
cp scratch/NFSeal.lean "$OD/NFSeal.lean"
bash scripts/lean_check_tree.sh scratch/NFSeal > "$OD/seal-module.log" 2>&1; echo "exit: $?" >> "$OD/seal-module.log"
# controls
HDR=$(sed -n '/^import/,/^section Controls/p' campaign/fills/c1/inputs/c1-fill-nf-cont1/NFContSealControl_sealed.lean.txt | grep -v '^section Controls')
for mode in unsealed sealed; do
  { echo "/- Seal controls for the owned module's seal ($N definitions): one delta goal per sealed"
    echo "definition, logging CONTROL_PASS or CONTROL_FAIL. Expected: unsealed, every control passes;"
    echo "sealed, every control fails. A probe record, not library code. -/"
    echo "import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.NTIME"
    echo "import TCSlib.Complexity.TuringMachine.NDCodes"
    echo "$HDR"
    cat <<'LEAN'

open Lean Elab Command Meta in
elab "#ctl_use " id:ident " : " t:term : command => do
  let ok ← liftTermElabM do
    try
      Term.withoutErrToSorry do
        let goal ← Term.elabType t
        let proof ← Term.elabTermEnsuringType (← `(by decide)) goal
        Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing
        return !(← instantiateMVars proof).hasSorry
    catch _ => return false
  logInfo m!"{if ok then "CONTROL_PASS" else "CONTROL_FAIL"} use {id.getId}"
LEAN
    echo; echo "section Controls"
    if [ "$mode" = sealed ]; then cat "$OD/seal-block.lean"; else echo "attribute [-simp] Turing.Action.apply Turing.Cfg.init Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg Turing.NDTM.initCfg"; fi
    while read -r d; do
      case "$d" in
        Turing.FinTM.sweepFold|Turing.NDTM.runWith|Turing.codeReadUnary|Turing.codeReadVec|Turing.codeSkipRepeat|Turing.incFixed|Turing.mealyRun|Turing.pairDecode|Turing.unaryTokenSplit|Turing.workReadsK)
          echo "#ctl_eqn $d" ;;
        Turing.instFintypeSeekPhase) echo "#ctl_use $d : (Finset.univ : Finset Turing.SeekPhase).card = 4" ;;
        Turing.instFintypeSweepPhase) echo "#ctl_use $d : (Finset.univ : Finset Turing.SweepPhase).card = 3" ;;
        Turing.instFintypeScanPhase) echo "#ctl_rfl $d" ;;
        Turing.instFintypeGuessRunPhase) echo "#ctl_use $d : (Finset.univ : Finset Turing.GuessRunPhase).card = 6" ;;
        *) echo "#ctl_rfl $d" ;;
      esac
    done < "$OD/seal-set.txt"
    echo "end Controls"; } > "scratch/NFSealCtl_$mode.lean"
  cp "scratch/NFSealCtl_$mode.lean" "$OD/NFSealCtl_$mode.lean"
  bash scripts/lean_check_tree.sh "scratch/NFSealCtl_$mode" > "$OD/controls-$mode.log" 2>&1; echo "exit: $?" >> "$OD/controls-$mode.log"
  echo "$mode: PASS=$(grep -c 'CONTROL_PASS' "$OD/controls-$mode.log") FAIL=$(grep -c 'CONTROL_FAIL' "$OD/controls-$mode.log")"
done
echo "module: $(grep -c 'error' "$OD/seal-module.log") error lines; $(tail -1 "$OD/seal-module.log")"

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/evidence/c1-nf-cont1/runtime/sweep.sh =====

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# sweep.sh <order-file> <log> [summary]
# Runs scripts/lean_check_tree.sh over each module of the order file, one at a time,
# logging start/end (UTC), wall time, max RSS and exit status per module.
set -u
source ~/.elan/env
cd /home/user/tcslib
ORDER="$1"; LOG="$2"; SUM="${3:-${2%.log}-summary.tsv}"
: > "$LOG"; printf 'module\tstart\tend\twall_s\tmaxrss_kb\texit\tsorry_warnings\n' > "$SUM"
fails=0
while read -r m; do
  [ -z "$m" ] && continue
  s=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ); s0=$(date +%s.%N)
  echo "=== BEGIN $m $s" >> "$LOG"
  tf=$(mktemp)
  /usr/bin/time -v -o "$tf" bash scripts/lean_check_tree.sh "$m" > "$tf.out" 2>&1
  st=$?
  cat "$tf.out" >> "$LOG"
  e=$(date -u +%FT%T.%3NZ); e0=$(date +%s.%N)
  rss=$(awk -F': ' '/Maximum resident/{print $2}' "$tf")
  ns=$(grep -c "declaration uses 'sorry'" "$tf.out")
  echo "=== END $m $e exit=$st wall=$(python3 -c "print(round($e0-$s0,2))")s maxrss_kb=$rss" >> "$LOG"
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$m" "$s" "$e" "$(python3 -c "print(round($e0-$s0,2))")" "$rss" "$st" "$ns" >> "$SUM"
  rm -f "$tf" "$tf.out"
  if [ "$st" -ne 0 ]; then fails=$((fails+1)); echo "SWEEP STOP at $m" >> "$LOG"; break; fi
done < "$ORDER"
echo "=== SWEEP DONE fails=$fails $(date -u +%FT%TZ)" >> "$LOG"

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/evidence/c1-nf-cont1/runtime/walk.lean.txt =====


/-! Verification tail (scratch only): the elaborated-constant walk of the new declarations and
their axioms. -/
open Lean Elab Command in
run_cmd do
  let env ← getEnv
  let first39 : List String := ["nf_pack", "nf_setup", "nf_ctlStep", "nf_ctlStop", "nf_ctl_position", "nf_ctl_stop_iff", "nf_record", "nf_record_last", "nf_record_choice", "nf_record_read", "nf_display", "nf_display_length", "nf_display_flag", "nf_display_firstStop", "nf_firstStop_records", "nf_display_prefix_length", "nf_decode", "nf_decode_record", "nf_decode_absent", "nf_Control", "nf_SweepState", "nf_complete", "nf_sweepStep", "nf_sweepInit", "nf_sweepPass", "nf_complete_record", "nf_complete_failed", "nf_complete_other", "nf_sweep_prefix", "nf_sweep_record", "nf_complete_output", "nf_sweepPass_output", "nf_sweep_run", "nf_sweep_records", "nf_display_records", "nf_sweep_display", "nf_complete_step", "nf_sweep_control_prefix", "nf_sweep_display_pass"]
  let mut news : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.map₂.toList do
    let u := (privateToUserName? n).getD n
    let s := u.toString
    if (s.startsWith "Turing.FinNDTM.nf_" || s.startsWith "Turing.FinNDTM.instDecidableEqNf_"
        || s.startsWith "Turing.FinNDTM.instFintypeNf_"
        || s.startsWith "Turing.FinNDTM.exists_codeNDTM_accepts_linear") then
      let base := (s.drop "Turing.FinNDTM.".length).takeWhile (· != '.')
      if !(first39.contains base) then news := news.push n
  let newsS := news.qsort (fun a b => a.toString < b.toString)
  let mut ext : Std.HashSet Name := {}
  for n in newsS do
    let some ci := env.find? n | continue
    for c in ci.type.getUsedConstants ++ ((ci.value?.map Expr.getUsedConstants).getD #[]) do
      if (env.getModuleIdxFor? c).isSome then ext := ext.insert c
  let mut lines : Array String := #[]
  for c in ext.toArray do
    let some idx := env.getModuleIdxFor? c | continue
    let m := env.header.moduleNames[idx.toNat]!
    let some ci := env.find? c | continue
    let kind := match ci with
      | .defnInfo _ => "def" | .thmInfo _ => "thm" | .axiomInfo _ => "axiom"
      | .opaqueInfo _ => "opaque" | .quotInfo _ => "quot" | .inductInfo _ => "induct"
      | .ctorInfo _ => "ctor" | .recInfo _ => "rec"
    lines := lines.push s!"{c}\t{kind}\t{m}"
  let linesS := lines.qsort (· < ·)
  logInfo m!"WALK_NEW {newsS.size}\n{"\n".intercalate (newsS.toList.map toString)}"
  logInfo m!"WALK_EXT {linesS.size}\n{"\n".intercalate linesS.toList}"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# walk.sh <outdir> : copy the owned module + walk tail, check it, extract the walk; then
# a second copy with #print axioms for every new declaration and the target.
set -u
source ~/.elan/env
cd /home/user/tcslib
OD="$1"; mkdir -p "$OD"
MOD=TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/NDNormalForm.lean
cat "$MOD" scratch/walk.lean.txt > scratch/NFWalk.lean
bash scripts/lean_check_tree.sh scratch/NFWalk > "$OD/walk-raw.log" 2>&1; echo "walk exit: $?" >> "$OD/walk-raw.log"
python3 - "$OD" <<'PY'
import sys,re
od=sys.argv[1]; t=open(od+'/walk-raw.log').read()
m=re.search(r'WALK_NEW (\d+)\n(.*?)(?=\nscratch/|\Z)',t,re.S); news=m.group(2).strip().split('\n')
m2=re.search(r'WALK_EXT (\d+)\n(.*?)(?=\nscratch/|\Z)',t,re.S); ext=m2.group(2).strip().split('\n')
open(od+'/walk-new.txt','w').write('\n'.join(news)+'\n')
open(od+'/walk-ext.tsv','w').write('\n'.join(e for e in ext if e.count('\t')==2)+'\n')
import subprocess
src=open('TCSlib/Complexity/ClassNP/NDNormalForm.lean').read().split('\n')
first=set(l.strip() for l in open('scratch/first39.txt'))
top=[]
for l in src:
    m=re.match(r'^private (?:theorem|def|instance|inductive|abbrev) (nf_[^ \n(:]+)',l)
    if m and m.group(1) not in first: top.append('Turing.FinNDTM.'+m.group(1))
open(od+'/new-decls.txt','w').write('\n'.join(top)+'\n')
PY
{ cat "$MOD"; echo; echo "namespace Turing.FinNDTM"; while read -r n; do s="${n#Turing.FinNDTM.}"; echo "#print axioms $s"; done < "$OD/new-decls.txt"; echo "#print axioms exists_codeNDTM_accepts_linear"; echo "end Turing.FinNDTM"; } > scratch/NFAxioms.lean
bash scripts/lean_check_tree.sh scratch/NFAxioms > "$OD/axioms-raw.log" 2>&1; echo "axioms exit: $?" >> "$OD/axioms-raw.log"
grep -c "depends on axioms\|does not depend" "$OD/axioms-raw.log"
