/-! ## NF review audit (appended by the reviewer; not part of the module) -/

open Lean Meta Elab Command

namespace NFAudit

def modName? (env : Environment) (n : Name) : Option Name :=
  (env.getModuleIdxFor? n).bind fun i => env.header.moduleNames[i.toNat]?

def isTCSlib (env : Environment) (n : Name) : Bool :=
  match modName? env n with
  | some m => m.getRoot == `TCSlib
  | none => false

def isLocal (env : Environment) (n : Name) : Bool :=
  (env.getModuleIdxFor? n).isNone && (env.find? n).isSome

def usedOf (env : Environment) (n : Name) : NameSet :=
  match env.find? n with
  | some ci => ci.getUsedConstantsAsSet
  | none => {}

def typeConsts (env : Environment) (n : Name) : NameSet :=
  match env.find? n with
  | some ci => ci.type.getUsedConstantsAsSet
  | none => {}

/-- The name with any private prefix removed. -/
def pub (n : Name) : Name := (privateToUserName? n).getD n

def sortNames (s : Array Name) : Array Name := s.qsort (fun a b => a.toString < b.toString)

def kindOf (n : Name) : MetaM String := do
  let env ← getEnv
  match env.find? n with
  | some (.thmInfo _) => return "thm"
  | some (.defnInfo _) =>
    let r ← getReducibilityStatus n
    let inst ← isInstance n
    let proj := env.isProjectionFn n
    let matcher := Lean.Meta.isMatcherCore env n
    let st ← getSimpTheorems
    let simpd := st.isDeclToUnfold n || st.isLemma (.decl n)
    let rs := match r with
      | .reducible => "reducible" | .semireducible => "semireducible" | .irreducible => "irreducible"
    return s!"def[{rs}{if inst then ",instance" else ""}{if proj then ",projection" else ""}{if matcher then ",matcher" else ""}{if simpd then ",@[simp]" else ""}]"
  | some (.ctorInfo _) => return "ctor"
  | some (.inductInfo _) => return "inductive"
  | some (.recInfo _) => return "recursor"
  | some (.opaqueInfo _) => return "opaque"
  | some (.axiomInfo _) => return "axiom"
  | some (.quotInfo _) => return "quot"
  | none => return "?"

/-- Local constants reached from `roots` (not entering `stops`), and the external constants
(including `stops`) that they use directly. -/
def walkLocal (env : Environment) (roots : Array Name) (stops : NameSet) : NameSet × NameSet := Id.run do
  let mut visited : NameSet := {}
  let mut ext : NameSet := {}
  let mut stack := roots
  while !stack.isEmpty do
    let c := stack.back!
    stack := stack.pop
    if visited.contains c then continue
    visited := visited.insert c
    for d in (usedOf env c).toList do
      if isLocal env d && !stops.contains d then
        unless visited.contains d do stack := stack.push d
      else
        ext := ext.insert d
  return (visited, ext)

/-- The frozen declarations (base) other than the target: none (the base had only the target). -/
def frozen : List Name := []

def stdAx : List Name := [``propext, ``Classical.choice, ``Quot.sound]

end NFAudit

open NFAudit in
/-- Every local constant's user name and kind, sorted (for the base/head comparison). -/
elab "#nf_locals" : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let mut out : Array String := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.map₂.toList do
    let k ← liftTermElabM <| kindOf n
    out := out.push s!"LOCAL {if isPrivateName n then "private" else "public"} {pub n} | {k}"
  out := out.qsort (· < ·)
  logInfo m!"LOCALS {out.size}:\n{String.intercalate "\n" out.toList}"

open NFAudit in
/-- Axioms of every local constant: the ones outside the standard three, and the counts. -/
elab "#nf_axioms_all" : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let mut std : Nat := 0
  let mut bad : Array String := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.map₂.toList do
    let axs ← liftCoreM <| collectAxioms n
    if axs.all (stdAx.contains ·) then std := std + 1
    else bad := bad.push s!"{pub n}: {axs}"
  bad := bad.qsort (· < ·)
  logInfo m!"AXIOMS-ALL: {std} local constants within the standard three; outside it {bad.size}:\n{String.intercalate "\n" bad.toList}"

open NFAudit in
/-- The walk from every new local constant and the target, stopping at the frozen declarations. -/
elab "#nf_walk" : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let frz := frozen
  let mut stops : NameSet := {}
  let mut roots : Array Name := #[]
  for (n, _) in env.constants.map₂.toList do
    let u := pub n
    -- a frozen declaration or one of its auxiliaries
    if frz.any (fun f => f == u || f.isPrefixOf u) then stops := stops.insert n
    else if (`Turing.FinNDTM).isPrefixOf u then roots := roots.push n
  let (loc, ext) := walkLocal env roots stops
  logInfo m!"ROOTS {roots.size} (every local constant under Turing.FinNDTM: the module, not the audit tail); reached {loc.size}"
  let rootsU := sortNames (roots.map pub)
  logInfo m!"ROOT NAMES:\n{rootsU}"
  let extA := sortNames ext.toList.toArray
  let tcs := extA.filter (isTCSlib env ·)
  let stopHits := extA.filter (stops.contains ·)
  logInfo m!"FROZEN DECLARATIONS USED by the new code: {sortNames (stopHits.map pub)}"
  let other := extA.filter (fun n => !isTCSlib env n && !isLocal env n)
  let mut lines : Array String := #[]
  for n in tcs do
    let k ← liftTermElabM <| kindOf n
    lines := lines.push s!"{n} | {k} | {(modName? env n).getD `none}"
  logInfo m!"DIRECT-TCSLIB {tcs.size}:\n{String.intercalate "\n" lines.toList}"
  let mut olines : Array String := #[]
  for n in other do
    let k ← liftTermElabM <| kindOf n
    olines := olines.push s!"{n} | {k} | {(modName? env n).getD `none}"
  logInfo m!"DIRECT-CORE/MATHLIB {other.size}:\n{String.intercalate "\n" olines.toList}"
  let priv := extA.filter fun n => isPrivateName n && !isLocal env n
  logInfo m!"DIRECT external private names: {priv}"
  let r3 := extA.filter fun n =>
    match n with
    | .str _ s => ["copyTM_run", "transferTM_run", "clearTM_run", "compareTM_run",
        "incrementTM_run_succ", "incrementTM_run_overflow"].contains s
    | _ => false
  logInfo m!"DIRECT R3 rows: {r3}"
  -- TCSlib definitions in the statements of the directly used TCSlib constants, and of the
  -- new local constants' types (statement-reached)
  let mut d2 : NameSet := {}
  for n in tcs ++ (sortNames loc.toList.toArray) do
    for d in (typeConsts env n).toList do
      if isTCSlib env d && !ext.contains d then d2 := d2.insert d
  let mut l2 : Array String := #[]
  for n in sortNames d2.toList.toArray do
    let k ← liftTermElabM <| kindOf n
    if k.startsWith "def" || k == "opaque" then
      l2 := l2.push s!"{n} | {k} | {(modName? env n).getD `none}"
  logInfo m!"STATEMENT-REACHED TCSlib definitions (not direct) {l2.size}:\n{String.intercalate "\n" l2.toList}"

open NFAudit in
/-- Every TCSlib definition outside this module that is semireducible, not an instance, not a
projection and not a matcher: the maximal seal's candidates. -/
elab "#nf_alldefs" : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let st ← liftTermElabM getSimpTheorems
  let mut out : Array String := #[]
  let mut simpd : Array String := #[]
  for (n, ci) in env.constants.map₁.toList do
    if let .defnInfo _ := ci then
      if isTCSlib env n && !isPrivateName n && !n.isInternalDetail then
        let r ← getReducibilityStatus n
        let inst ← liftTermElabM <| isInstance n
        let proj := env.isProjectionFn n
        let matcher := Lean.Meta.isMatcherCore env n
        if st.isDeclToUnfold n || st.isLemma (.decl n) then
          simpd := simpd.push s!"{n}"
        if r == .semireducible && !inst && !proj && !matcher then
          out := out.push s!"{n}"
  out := out.qsort (· < ·)
  simpd := simpd.qsort (· < ·)
  logInfo m!"ALLDEFS {out.size}:\n{String.intercalate "\n" out.toList}"
  logInfo m!"SIMPDEFS {simpd.size}:\n{String.intercalate "\n" simpd.toList}"

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/axprobe.py =====

```
"""Axiom probe (standard library only; python3 -I).

Usage:
  python3 -I axprobe.py make <outdir>      writes <outdir>/work/ax/AxProbe.lean: a copy of the fit
                                           file (closure: every landing module) with `#print axioms`
                                           for every public declaration of the unit's parts and of
                                           the fit namespace
  python3 -I axprobe.py summary <outdir>   classifies the printed axioms
"""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import re
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sigprobe', os.path.join(HERE, 'sigprobe.py'))
sp = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(sp)
STD = {'propext', 'Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound'}


def make(out):
    unit = open(os.path.join(out, 'Contract-mig0b-r2-unit.lean'), encoding='utf-8').read()
    names = []
    for chunk in unit.split('\n/-! ' + '═' * 96)[1:]:
        body = chunk[chunk.index('\n', chunk.rindex('\n-- @')) + 1:]
        land = re.search(r'-- @landing (\S+)', chunk).group(1)
        for n in sp.public(body):
            names.append((land, n))
    fit = open(os.path.join(out, 'fit-tests.lean'), encoding='utf-8').read()
    names += [('fit', n) for n in sp.public(fit)]
    src = open([os.path.join(out, 'cut', f) for f in os.listdir(os.path.join(out, 'cut')) if f.startswith('TCSlib.Evidence.MIG0bR2Fit.')][0],
               encoding='utf-8').read()
    d = os.path.join(out, 'work', 'ax')
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    open(os.path.join(d, 'AxProbe.lean'), 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(
        src.rstrip('\n') + '\n\n' + ''.join(f'#print axioms {n}\n' for _, n in names))
    json.dump(names, open(os.path.join(d, 'names.json'), 'w'), indent=0)
    print('prints', len(names))


def summary(out):
    names = json.load(open(os.path.join(out, 'work', 'ax', 'names.json')))
    txt = open(os.path.join(out, 'work', 'ax', 'AxProbe.lean.out'), encoding='utf-8').read()
    txt = re.sub(r'\n\s+', ' ', txt)
    res = {}
    for m in re.finditer(r"'([^']+)' depends on axioms: \[([^\]]*)\]", txt):
        res[m.group(1)] = {a.strip() for a in m.group(2).split(',')}
    for m in re.finditer(r"'([^']+)' does not depend on any axioms", txt):
        res[m.group(1)] = set()
    lines, sorry, nonstd = [], [], []
    by_land = {}
    for land, n in names:
        assert n in res, n
        by_land.setdefault(land, []).append(n)
        if 'sorryAx' in res[n]:
            sorry.append(n)
        if res[n] - STD - {'sorryAx'}:
            nonstd.append(n)
    lines.append(f'printed: {len(names)} (every public declaration of the 13 parts, and of the '
                 f'fit namespace); outputs parsed: {len(res)}')
    for land, ns in by_land.items():
        lines.append(f'* {land}: {len(ns)}')
    lines.append(f'depending on sorryAx: {sorry}')
    lines.append(f'depending on an axiom outside propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound: '
                 f'{nonstd or "none"}')
    print('\n'.join(lines))
    open(os.path.join(out, 'work', 'axioms-summary.log'), 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(
        '\n'.join(lines) + '\n')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    (make if sys.argv[1] == 'make' else summary)(sys.argv[2])
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/census.py =====

```
"""Text-scan sorry census, before/after, over a module list.
usage: python3 -I census.py <modules.txt> <before-root> <after-root>
Counts comment-stripped `sorry` tokens per file and names the declaration enclosing each
(the nearest preceding declaration header in the comment-stripped text). A missing file
counts as absent (0).
"""
import os, re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from leanlib import strip_keep_lines, decls

mods, broot, aroot = sys.argv[1:4]
TOK = re.compile(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.\'])sorry(?![A-Za-z0-9_\'])')
def scan(path):
    if not os.path.exists(path): return None, []
    s = strip_keep_lines(open(path, encoding='utf-8').read())
    ds = decls(s); lines = s.split('\n'); hits = []
    for ln, l in enumerate(lines, 1):
        for _ in TOK.finditer(l):
            owner = None
            for d in ds:
                if d['line'] <= ln: owner = d
                else: break
            hits.append((ln, owner['name'] if owner else '?'))
    return len(hits), hits
tb = ta = 0; changed = []
print('module | before | after | sorried declarations after')
for m in [l.strip() for l in open(mods) if l.strip()]:
    f = m + '.lean'
    nb, hb = scan(os.path.join(broot, f)); na, ha = scan(os.path.join(aroot, f))
    tb += nb or 0; ta += na or 0
    names = sorted({h[1] for h in ha})
    print(f"{f} | {'absent' if nb is None else nb} | {na} | {', '.join(names)}")
    if (nb or 0) != (na or 0): changed.append((f, nb, na, sorted({h[1] for h in hb}), names))
print(f'TOTAL sorry tokens: before {tb}, after {ta}')
print('files whose count changed:')
for f, nb, na, b, a in changed:
    print(f'  {f}: {nb} -> {na}; before: {b}; after: {a}')
```

```
"""Join the tactic-argument rows with their kinds (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I classify.py <tacargs.tsv> <kinds .out>"""
import re, sys
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
rows = [l.rstrip('\n').split('\t') for l in open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()]
K = defaultdict(list)
for l in open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8'):
    if l.startswith('KIND '):
        n, full, kind, mod = [x.strip() for x in l[5:].split('|')]
        K[n].append((full, kind, mod))
def cls(x):
    x = x.lstrip('←').strip()
    if x == '-' or x == '_' or re.search(r'\.[0-9]', x): return [('local', x, '-', '-')]
    out = []
    for full, kind, mod in K.get(x, [('-', 'local (not a global constant)', '-')]):
        if kind.startswith('local'): out.append(('local', x, '-', '-'))
        elif mod == 'this_module': out.append(('own', full, kind, mod))
        elif mod.startswith('TCSlib'): out.append(('tcslib', full, kind, mod))
        else: out.append(('core/mathlib', full, kind, mod))
    return out
ARGK = {'rw', 'rwa', 'simp', 'simp only', 'simpa', 'simpa only', 'dsimp', 'dsimp only', 'unfold', 'delta',
        'simp_all', 'simp_all only', 'simp_rw', 'nth_rw', 'norm_num', 'field_simp'}
tally = Counter(); findings = []; showdefs = defaultdict(set); distinct = defaultdict(set)
for k, x, ln in rows:
    for c, full, kind, mod in cls(x):
        cat = c
        if c in ('tcslib', 'core/mathlib'):
            cat = f'{c} {kind.split("[")[0]}'
        tally[(k if k in ARGK else k, cat)] += 1
        distinct[cat].add(full if c != 'local' else x)
        if k in ARGK and c in ('tcslib', 'core/mathlib') and kind.startswith('def'):
            findings.append((k, full, kind, mod, ln))
        if k in ARGK and c == 'tcslib' and kind == 'opaque':
            findings.append((k, full, kind, mod, ln))
        if k == 'show term' and c in ('tcslib', 'core/mathlib') and kind.startswith('def'):
            showdefs[(c, full, kind)].add(int(ln))
print('## rows by tactic kind and class')
for (k, cat), v in sorted(tally.items()): print(f'  {k:16s} {cat:28s} {v}')
print('## distinct identifiers per class')
for cat, s in sorted(distinct.items()): print(f'  {cat}: {len(s)}')
print('## definitions (or opaques) of other files or of core/Mathlib passed to rw/simp/dsimp/unfold:')
for f in findings: print('  ', f)
if not findings: print('   none')
print('## definitions named in show/change terms (other files and core/Mathlib), with their lines:')
for (c, full, kind), lns in sorted(showdefs.items()): print(f'   {c} {full} {kind}: {sorted(lns)}')
print('## other-file TCSlib theorems passed to rw/simp (distinct):')
print('  ', sorted({full for k, x, ln in rows if k in ARGK for c, full, kind, mod in cls(x) if c == 'tcslib' and kind == 'thm'}))
print('## other-file TCSlib non-theorem, non-definition names in rw/simp lists:')
print('  ', sorted({(full, kind) for k, x, ln in rows if k in ARGK for c, full, kind, mod in cls(x) if c == 'tcslib' and kind not in ('thm',) and not kind.startswith('def')}))
print('## core/Mathlib non-theorem names in rw/simp lists:')
print('  ', sorted({(full, kind) for k, x, ln in rows if k in ARGK for c, full, kind, mod in cls(x) if c == 'core/mathlib' and kind != 'thm'}))
```

```
"""Upstream and downstream import closures of a module, from imports.py's JSON (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I closure2.py <imports.json> <module> [<order list>] [<probe module> ...]"""
import json, sys
mods = json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); m = sys.argv[2]
order = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 and sys.argv[3].endswith('.txt') else None
probes = sys.argv[4:] if order else sys.argv[3:]
def up(m, seen=None):
    seen = set() if seen is None else seen
    for d in mods.get(m, []):
        if d not in seen: seen.add(d); up(d, seen)
    return seen
U = up(m)
D = sorted(x for x in mods if m in up(x))
print(f'{m}: upstream {len(U)} TCSlib modules; downstream {len(D)}: {D}')
for p in probes: print(f'  {p}: in upstream {p in U}; in downstream {p in D}')
if order:
    O = [l.strip() for l in open(order) if l.strip() and not l.startswith('#')]
    S = set(O)
    print(f'order list: {len(O)} modules; upstream within it: {len(U & S)}/{len(U)}; missing: {sorted(U - S)}')
    pos = {x: i for i, x in enumerate(O)}
    bad = [(x, d) for x in O for d in mods.get(x, []) if d not in pos or pos[d] > pos[x]]
    print(f'order list import-closed and topological: {not bad} {bad[:5]}')
    print(f'downstream modules in the order list: {[d for d in D if d in S]}; not in it: {[d for d in D if d not in S]}')
```

```
import sys
def strip(src):
    out, i, depth = [], 0, 0
    while i < len(src):
        if src.startswith('/-', i): depth += 1; i += 2; continue
        if src.startswith('-/', i) and depth > 0: depth -= 1; i += 2; continue
        if depth == 0: out.append(src[i])
        i += 1
    return [l.split('--')[0].rstrip() for l in ''.join(out).split('\n') if l.split('--')[0].strip()]
a, b = (strip(open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()) for p in sys.argv[1:3])
print('code identical (comments stripped)' if a == b else 'CODE DIFFERS')
```

```
"""Coverage of the direct externals (the audit walk) by the import probes' #check names (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I coverage.py <audit .out> <brief probe> <worker probe>"""
import re, sys
T = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
def section(head):
    i = next(k for k, l in enumerate(T) if l.startswith(head))
    out = []
    for l in T[i + 1:]:
        m = re.match(r'^(\S+) \| ', l)
        if not m: break
        out.append(m.group(1))
    return out
tcs = section('DIRECT-TCSLIB'); core = section('DIRECT-CORE/MATHLIB')
def checks(p):
    s = set()
    for l in open(p, encoding='utf-8'):
        m = re.match(r'#check\s+@?(\S+)', l.strip())
        if m: s.add(m.group(1).lstrip('@').lstrip('_root_.'))
    return s
B = checks(sys.argv[2]); W = checks(sys.argv[3])
def norm(n): return n[len('Turing.'):] if n.startswith('Turing.') else n
def covered(n, S): return n in S or norm(n) in S or ('Turing.' + n) in S
aux = lambda n: bool(re.search(r'\._proof_|\.match_|\._simp_|\._unary|\._sunfold|\.eq_\d|\._eq_', n))
print('direct TCSlib externals', len(tcs), '; core/Mathlib', len(core))
print('TCSlib not covered by the brief probe (149 checks):', [n for n in tcs if not covered(n, B)])
print('TCSlib not covered by the worker probe:', [n for n in tcs if not covered(n, W)])
nc = [n for n in core if not covered(n, W) and not aux(n)]
print('core/Mathlib (non-auxiliary) not covered by the worker probe:', len(nc), nc[:40])
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/declfreeze.py =====

```
import re, sys
KW = r'(theorem|lemma|def|abbrev|instance|structure|inductive|class)'
DECL = re.compile(r'^(@\[[^\]]*\]\s*)*((private|protected|noncomputable|nonrec|partial|unsafe)\s+)*' + KW + r'\s+([^\s(:{\[]+)')
# v3 (gate 69 round 2 and gate 71, minor 1): anonymous instances are declarations too; they
# were skipped and their text absorbed into the previous chunk. Each is keyed by its statement.
ANON = re.compile(r'^(@\[[^\]]*\]\s*)*((private|protected|noncomputable|nonrec|partial|unsafe)\s+)*instance(?=\s*[(:{\[]|\s*$)')
STOP = re.compile(r'^(end\b|namespace\b|section\b|/-!|open\b|variable\b|set_option\b|#|attribute\b|universe\b)')
# v4 (gate 78, minor 2): declarations are keyed by their namespace-qualified name, so that two
# declarations with one short name in different namespaces (`Segment.trans`, `SafeSegment.trans`) are not
# collapsed; a name that is still not unique gets `#k` (k-th in source order).
SCOPE = re.compile(r'^(?:(namespace)\s+(\S+)|(?:noncomputable\s+)?(section)\b\s*(\S*)|(mutual)\b|(end)\b\s*(\S*))')
def chunks(text):
    lines = text.split('\n'); out = []; pend = None; cur = None; depth = 0; stack = []
    def ns():
        return '.'.join(n for k, n in stack if k == 'namespace')
    def qualify(name):
        if name.startswith('_root_.'): return name[len('_root_.'):]
        return f'{ns()}.{name}' if ns() else name
    def close(i):
        nonlocal cur
        if cur:
            text = '\n'.join(lines[cur[2]:i]).rstrip()
            name = cur[0]
            if name is None:
                name = 'instance⟨' + stmt(text) + '⟩'
                while any(n == name for n, _, _ in out): name += "'"
            else:
                base = name; k = 1
                while any(n == name for n, _, _ in out): k += 1; name = f'{base}#{k}'
            out.append((name, cur[1], text))
        cur = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        # v2 (B5b gate, minor 5): a line that starts inside a block comment or docstring is never
        # a declaration or a stop line (a docstring line "instance of ..." was counted as one).
        start_depth, j = depth, 0
        while j < len(l):
            if l.startswith('/-', j): depth += 1; j += 2; continue
            if l.startswith('-/', j) and depth > 0: depth -= 1; j += 2; continue
            if depth == 0 and l.startswith('--', j): break
            j += 1
        if start_depth > 0: continue
        if l.startswith('/--'):
            close(i); pend = i; continue
        m = DECL.match(l)
        if m:
            if pend is None: close(i)
            start = pend if pend is not None else i; pend = None
            cur = (qualify(m.group(5)), l.lstrip().startswith('private') or ' private ' in l.split(m.group(4))[0], start)
            continue
        m = ANON.match(l)
        if m:
            if pend is None: close(i)
            start = pend if pend is not None else i; pend = None
            cur = (None, l.lstrip().startswith('private'), start)
            continue
        if STOP.match(l):
            close(i); pend = None
            sm = SCOPE.match(l)
            if sm:
                if sm.group(1): stack += [('namespace', c) for c in sm.group(2).split('.')]
                elif sm.group(3): stack.append(('section', sm.group(4)))
                elif sm.group(5): stack.append(('mutual', ''))
                else:
                    for c in reversed(sm.group(7).split('.')):
                        if stack and stack[-1][1] == c: stack.pop()
                        elif stack and c == '': stack.pop()
    close(len(lines))
    return out
def stmt(t):
    body = t.split('-/', 1)[1] if t.startswith('/--') else t
    s = re.split(r':=', body, maxsplit=1)[0]
    return ' '.join(s.split())
a = chunks(open(sys.argv[1]).read()); b = chunks(open(sys.argv[2]).read())
allowed = set(sys.argv[3].split(',')) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else set()
A = {n: (p, t) for n, p, t in a}; B = {n: (p, t) for n, p, t in b}
pubA = {n for n, (p, _) in A.items() if not p}; pubB = {n for n, (p, _) in B.items() if not p}
print('public before/after:', len(pubA), len(pubB), 'private before/after:', len(A) - len(pubA), len(B) - len(pubB))
print('public added:', sorted(pubB - pubA)); print('public removed:', sorted(pubA - pubB))
for n in sorted(pubA & pubB):
    ta, tb = A[n][1], B[n][1]
    if stmt(ta) != stmt(tb): print('STATEMENT CHANGED:', n)
    elif ta != tb:
        ok = n in allowed or any(n.endswith('.' + x) for x in allowed)  # short names still accepted
        print(('authorized body change: ' if ok else 'UNAUTHORIZED BODY CHANGE: ') + n)
privA = {n for n in A if A[n][0]}; privB = {n for n in B if B[n][0]}
print('private removed:', sorted(privA - privB)); print('private added:', sorted(privB - privA))
print('private changed:', sorted(n for n in privA & privB if A[n][1] != B[n][1]))
```

```
"""Docstrings, proof lengths and sketches of the new declarations; campaign words in new text
(python3 -I).  usage: python3 -I doccheck.py <base> <head>"""
import re, sys, difflib
A = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n'); B = open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
DECL = re.compile(r'^(private\s+)?(theorem|def|abbrev|lemma|instance|structure|inductive)\s+(\S+)')
decls = [(i, m.group(3), m.group(2), bool(m.group(1))) for i, l in enumerate(B) for m in [DECL.match(l)] if m]
print('## declarations at head:', len(decls))
rows = []
for k, (i, name, kind, priv) in enumerate(decls):
    end = decls[k + 1][0] if k + 1 < len(decls) else len(B)
    # back off the next declaration's docstring
    j = end
    while j > i and not B[j - 1].startswith('/--') and j != end - 0 and False: j -= 1
    seg = B[i:end]
    # the next docstring starts at the last '/--' line before end
    cut = len(seg)
    for t in range(len(seg) - 1, 0, -1):
        if seg[t].startswith('/--'): cut = t; break
        if seg[t].startswith('end ') or seg[t].startswith('namespace'): cut = t
    seg = seg[:cut]
    while seg and not seg[-1].strip(): seg.pop()
    proof = 0
    for t, l in enumerate(seg):
        if ':= by' in l or l.rstrip().endswith(':=') or ' := ' in l:
            proof = len(seg) - t - 1; break
    # docstring above
    d = i - 1
    doc = []
    if d >= 0 and B[d].rstrip().endswith('-/'):
        s = d
        while not B[s].startswith('/--'): s -= 1
        doc = B[s:d + 1]
    sketch = any('**Proof sketch.**' in l for l in doc)
    rows.append((i + 1, name, kind, priv, len(doc), proof, sketch))
for r in rows:
    flag = 'NEEDS SKETCH' if r[5] > 20 and not r[6] else ''
    print(f'  head {r[0]:4d} {"private " if r[3] else "public  "}{r[2]:8s} {r[1]:32s} doc {r[4]:2d} lines; proof {r[5]:3d} lines; sketch {r[6]} {flag}')
print('without a docstring:', [r[1] for r in rows if r[4] == 0])
print('proofs over 20 lines without a sketch:', [r[1] for r in rows if r[5] > 20 and not r[6]])
print('proofs over 20 lines:', [(r[1], r[5]) for r in rows if r[5] > 20])
sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=A, b=B, autojunk=False)
added = [(j + 1, B[j]) for tag, a1, a2, b1, b2 in sm.get_opcodes() if tag != 'equal' for j in range(b1, b2)]
pat = re.compile(r'\b(NF|C1|E-?Q|checkpoint|cp\d|gate|finding|round|phase P|P3\.3|campaign|audits?/|brief|ruling|D[1-4]\b|rule 1[01]|user,|20\d\d-\d\d-\d\d|fill|worker|Codex|review|sweep 0|sweep zero|sorry)\b', re.I)
print('## campaign-like words in added lines (all hits; judged in REVIEW.md):')
for n, l in added:
    for m in pat.finditer(l): print(f'  head {n}: [{m.group(0)}] {l.strip()[:110]}')
```

```
import os, re, sys, json
root = sys.argv[1]
mods = {}
for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(os.path.join(root, 'TCSlib')):
    for f in fn:
        if f.endswith('.lean'):
            p = os.path.join(dp, f)
            m = os.path.relpath(p, root)[:-5]
            imps = []
            with open(p, encoding='utf-8') as fh:
                for line in fh:
                    s = line.strip()
                    mm = re.match(r'^import\s+(\S+)', s)
                    if mm:
                        name = mm.group(1)
                        if name.startswith('TCSlib'):
                            imps.append(name.replace('.', '/'))
            mods[m] = imps
json.dump(mods, open(sys.argv[2], 'w'))
print(len(mods))
```

open Lean Meta Elab Command in
elab "#nf_kinds " ids:ident* : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let mut lines : Array String := #[]
  for id in ids do
    let n := id.getId
    let cands ← liftCoreM <| (do
      try
        let r ← resolveGlobalConst id
        pure r
      catch _ => pure [])
    if cands.isEmpty then
      lines := lines.push s!"KIND {n} | - | local (not a global constant) | -"
    else
      for c in cands do
        let k ← liftTermElabM <| NFAudit.kindOf c
        let m := (NFAudit.modName? env c).getD `this_module
        lines := lines.push s!"KIND {n} | {NFAudit.pub c} | {k} | {m}"
  logInfo m!"{String.intercalate "\n" lines.toList}"

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/landing_edits.py =====

```
"""Apply the review's landing edits E1-E3 to the head's owned file, asserting each (python3 -I).
E1 removes one blank line from each double blank line; E2 rewords five docstrings (the control
sweep instead of "sweep 0/zero", tape `0` instead of "A", the width named, the final flag stated); E3 adds an
**Implementation.** paragraph to the target's docstring.
usage: python3 -I landing_edits.py <head.lean> <out.lean>"""
import sys
src, out = sys.argv[1:3]
t = open(src, encoding='utf-8').read()
def rep(old, new, count=1):
    global t
    assert t.count(old) == count, (t.count(old), old[:80])
    t = t.replace(old, new)
# E1: the four double blank lines (head 91-92, 540-541, 584-585, 626-627)
rep('\n\n\n', '\n\n', 4)
assert '\n\n\n' not in t
# E2: docstring wording
rep('/-- Sweep zero begins at the start state with an empty record and output summary. -/',
    '/-- The control sweep begins at the start state with an empty record and output summary. -/')
rep('''/-- **Sweep 0 is the published scan fold.** From the entry configuration with the scan's
forward state, the scan on tape `0` reaches the completed bit fold at
exactly `2|s| + 2`, not at any `done` before, with every tape, head, the input head and the
output as at the entry: A's head is back at `0` with no separate rewind.''',
    '''/-- **The control sweep is the fold instance of `Turing.scanTM`.** From the stream start with
the scan's forward state, the scan on tape `0` reaches the completed bit fold at exactly
`2|s| + 2`, not at any `done` before, with every tape, head, the input head and the output as at
the start: the head of tape `0` is back at cell `0` with no separate rewind.''')
rep('/-- Sweep zero passes the display of a branch that first halts at its end with output',
    '/-- The control sweep passes the display of a branch that first halts at its end with output')
rep('''**Proof sketch.** The final cell of record `r` has index `W(r+1)-1`. Its quotient by `W`
is `r` and its remainder is `W-1`, so the record encoder returns the prescribed end flag. -/''',
    '''**Proof sketch.** With the width `W = 2k + 4`, the final cell of record `r` has index
`W(r+1)-1`. Its quotient by `W` is `r` and its remainder is `W-1`, so the record encoder returns
the prescribed end flag. -/''')
rep('''/-- A stream that first stops the controller consists of a positive number of complete
records, with false end flags on all but the final record.''',
    '''/-- A stream that first stops the controller consists of a positive number of complete
records, with false end flags on all but the final record, whose end flag is true.''')
# E3: the target's Implementation paragraph
rep('''`exists_codeTM` precedent). Fill obligations, named: the display format and
its on-the-fly control check; the `k + 1` verification sweeps; the two
transfer directions; the relabeling packaging. -/''',
    '''`exists_codeTM` precedent). Fill obligations, named: the display format and
its on-the-fly control check; the `k + 1` verification sweeps; the two
transfer directions; the relabeling packaging.

**Implementation.** The display refines the sketch: one record of `2k + 4`
bits per step of `N`, holding the step's choice bit, the claimed input and
work-tape reads (two bits each: `00` blank, `10` false, `11` true) and an end
flag, set on the last record only. States and actions are not guessed: the
verifier recomputes them from `N`'s table in its finite control. The guess
runs under the controller-stopped host `Turing.guessCtlRunTM` with a trivial
setup; its controller stops at the first record boundary after a set end
flag. The verifier is deterministic and silent: a control sweep (a fold by
`Turing.scanTM`) checks the recomputed states, the end flags and the output,
and replay sweeps check the claimed reads against the input and, on the
second work tape, against each replayed work tape, which `Turing.skipTM`,
`Turing.skipBackTM` and `Turing.clearTM` then erase. -/''')
for w in ('Sweep 0', 'Sweep zero', "A's head", 'published'):
    assert w not in t, w
assert max(len(l) for l in t.split('\n')) <= 100
import re
assert not [l for l in t.split('\n') if re.match(r'(instance|theorem|lemma|def|abbrev|end|namespace|section|open|structure|inductive|class)\s+(of|the|a|an|by|at|is|on|in)\b', l)], 'a docstring line starts with a keyword'
open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(t)
print('wrote', out, len(t.split('\n')) - 1, 'lines')
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/mkaudit.py =====

```
"""Build the review's audit probe: the head module with `import Lean` after its last import, the
audit tail, the kinds tail and the sorry-user command, `#print axioms` for the target and every
private, then the audit commands and the kinds of the tactic-argument identifiers (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I mkaudit.py <head.lean> <audit tail> <kinds tail> <sorry tail> <ids> <out>"""
import re, sys
src, t1, t2, t3, idsf, out = sys.argv[1:7]
L = open(src, encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
last = max(i for i, l in enumerate(L) if l.startswith('import '))
L.insert(last + 1, 'import Lean')
assert L[-2] == 'end Turing' and L[-1] == '', L[-3:]
privs = [m.group(2) for l in L for m in [re.match(r'^private (theorem|def|abbrev) (\S+)', l)] if m]
assert len(privs) == 39, len(privs)
ids = [i.lstrip('←').strip() for i in open(idsf, encoding='utf-8').read().split() if i.strip() and i.strip() != '_']
text = '\n'.join(L[:-1]) + '\n'
for t in (t1, t2, t3): text += open(t, encoding='utf-8').read() + '\n'
text += '\nnamespace Turing.FinNDTM\n\n#print axioms exists_codeNDTM_accepts_linear\n'
text += ''.join(f'#print axioms {n}\n' for n in privs) + '\n'
for k in range(0, len(ids), 40):
    text += '#nf_kinds ' + ' '.join(ids[k:k + 40]) + '\n'
text += '\nend Turing.FinNDTM\n\n#nf_locals\n\n#nf_axioms_all\n\n#nf_sorry_users\n\n#nf_walk\n\n#nf_alldefs\n'
open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text)
print('wrote', out, len(text.split('\n')), 'lines;', len(privs), 'privates;', len(ids), 'identifiers')
```

```
"""Build the review's maximal seal of the head module, with non-erroring controls (python3 -I).
Adapted from the E-Q cont1 review's mkseal3.py.  The seal block sits at the top of region (b)
(before `nf_pack`'s docstring, head line 45): `attribute [-simp]` on the four `@[simp]` TCSlib
definitions and `attribute [local irreducible]` on every semireducible, non-instance,
non-projection, non-matcher, non-private TCSlib definition of the environment outside this module
(the audit's ALLDEFS).  The controls sit before `end FinNDTM`, so that the local seal applies;
each logs one info line (`CONTROL_PASS <kind> <name>` or `CONTROL_FAIL <kind> <name>`).  Kinds:
`rfl` (the goal `c = <its value>` by `rfl`), `eqn` (the first equation lemma of `c`, by
`intros; rfl`; only recursive definitions have one) and `simp` (the pointwise unfolding goal of
a `@[simp]` definition, by `intros; simp`).  The unsealed copy replaces the block by blank lines.
usage: python3 -I mkseal.py <head.lean> <alldefs.txt> <outdir>"""
import os, sys
src, alld, outd = sys.argv[1:4]
L = open(src, encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
assert L[42] == 'namespace FinNDTM' and L[43] == '' and L[44].startswith('/-- A finite-state machine'), L[42:45]
assert L[-4] == 'end FinNDTM' and L[-3] == '' and L[-2] == 'end Turing' and L[-1] == '', L[-4:]
seal = [l.strip() for l in open(alld, encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()]
assert len(seal) == len(set(seal)), 'duplicates'
simpdefs = ['Turing.Action.apply', 'Turing.Cfg.init', 'Turing.MultiTapeTM.initCfg', 'Turing.NDTM.initCfg']
assert all(d in seal for d in simpdefs)
block = ['-- review seal (maximal): every semireducible, non-instance, non-projection TCSlib',
         f'-- definition outside this module ({len(seal)}), and the four @[simp] TCSlib definitions erased',
         'attribute [-simp] ' + ' '.join(simpdefs),
         'attribute [local irreducible]'] + ['  ' + d for d in seal] + ['']
ctl = ['', '-- controls (inside the namespace, so that the local seal applies); each logs one info line',
       'open Lean Elab Command Meta in',
       'elab "#ctl_rfl " id:ident : command => do',
       '  let n ← liftCoreM (realizeGlobalConstNoOverload id)',
       '  let ci ← getConstInfo n',
       '  let some value := ci.value? | throwError "not a definition: {n}"',
       '  let ok ← liftTermElabM do',
       '    try',
       '      Term.withoutErrToSorry do',
       '        let goal ← mkEq (mkConst n (ci.levelParams.map Level.param)) value',
       '        let proof ← Term.elabTermEnsuringType (← `(by rfl)) goal',
       '        Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing',
       '        return !(← instantiateMVars proof).hasSorry',
       '    catch _ => return false',
       '  logInfo m!"{if ok then "CONTROL_PASS" else "CONTROL_FAIL"} rfl {n}"', '',
       'open Lean Elab Command Meta in',
       'elab "#ctl_eqn " id:ident : command => do',
       '  let n ← liftCoreM (realizeGlobalConstNoOverload id)',
       '  let ok ← liftTermElabM do',
       '    try',
       '      let some eqs ← getEqnsFor? n | return false',
       '      let ty := (← getConstInfo eqs[0]!).type',
       '      Term.withoutErrToSorry do',
       '        let proof ← Term.elabTermEnsuringType (← `(by intros; rfl)) ty',
       '        Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing',
       '        return !(← instantiateMVars proof).hasSorry',
       '    catch _ => return false',
       '  logInfo m!"{if ok then "CONTROL_PASS" else "CONTROL_FAIL"} eqn {n}"', '',
       'open Lean Elab Command Meta in',
       'elab "#ctl_simp " id:ident : command => do',
       '  let n ← liftCoreM (realizeGlobalConstNoOverload id)',
       '  let ci ← getConstInfo n',
       '  let some value := ci.value? | throwError "not a definition: {n}"',
       '  let ok ← liftTermElabM do',
       '    try',
       '      Term.withoutErrToSorry do',
       '        let c := mkConst n (ci.levelParams.map Level.param)',
       '        let goal ← forallTelescopeReducing ci.type fun xs _ => do',
       '          mkForallFVars xs (← mkEq (mkAppN c xs) (mkAppN value xs).headBeta)',
       '        let proof ← Term.elabTermEnsuringType (← `(by intros; simp)) goal',
       '        Term.synthesizeSyntheticMVarsNoPostponing',
       '        return !(← instantiateMVars proof).hasSorry',
       '    catch _ => return false',
       '  logInfo m!"{if ok then "CONTROL_PASS" else "CONTROL_FAIL"} simp {n}"', '']
ctl += [f'#ctl_rfl {d}' for d in seal] + ['']
ctl += [f'#ctl_eqn {d}' for d in seal] + ['']
ctl += [f'#ctl_simp {d}' for d in simpdefs] + ['']
nb = len(block)
body_sealed = L[:44] + block + L[44:-4] + ctl + L[-4:]
body_unsealed = L[:44] + [''] * nb + L[44:-4] + ctl + L[-4:]
os.makedirs(outd, exist_ok=True)
for name, b in [('NFSeal_sealed.lean', body_sealed), ('NFSeal_unsealed.lean', body_unsealed)]:
    open(os.path.join(outd, name), 'w', encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(b))
print('sealed', len(seal), 'definitions; erased', len(simpdefs), '; controls', len(seal), 'rfl +', len(seal),
      'eqn +', len(simpdefs), 'simp; module body (new code onward) at sealed lines', 45 + nb, '-', len(L) - 4 + nb)
```

```
"""The head with its four unrestricted simp calls turned into simp? / simp_all? (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I mksimpq.py <head.lean> <out.lean>"""
import sys
L = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
edits = {137: ('  | nil => simp [nf_ctlStop]', '  | nil => simp? [nf_ctlStop]'),
         145: ("      simp [nf_ctlStop, hz']", "      simp? [nf_ctlStop, hz']"),
         153: ("      simp [nf_ctlStop, hn']", "      simp? [nf_ctlStop, hn']"),
         580: ('    split_ifs with h hj <;> simp_all', '    split_ifs with h hj <;> simp_all?')}
for n, (a, b) in edits.items():
    assert L[n - 1] == a, (n, L[n - 1]); L[n - 1] = b
open(sys.argv[2], 'w', encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(L))
print('wrote', sys.argv[2])
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/overlaps.py =====

```
"""Lean-run intervals from the worker's logs (START/END lines) and their pairwise overlaps (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I overlaps.py <logs dir>"""
import os, re, sys
from datetime import datetime
d = sys.argv[1]; iv = []
for f in sorted(os.listdir(d)):
    if not f.endswith('.log'): continue
    starts = {}
    for l in open(os.path.join(d, f), encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'):
        m = re.match(r'^(START|END) (\S+) (\S+)', l)
        if not m: continue
        t = datetime.fromisoformat(m.group(2)); k = m.group(3)
        if m.group(1) == 'START': starts[k] = t
        elif k in starts: iv.append((starts.pop(k), t, f, k))
    for k, t in starts.items(): iv.append((t, None, f, k + ' (no END)'))
iv.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
print('lean runs with START/END:', len(iv))
ov = []
done = [x for x in iv if x[1]]
for i, a in enumerate(done):
    for b in done[i + 1:]:
        if b[0] >= a[1]: break
        ov.append((a, b))
print('overlapping pairs:', len(ov))
for a, b in ov[:20]: print(f'  {a[2]}:{a[3]} {a[0].time()}-{a[1].time()}  ||  {b[2]}:{b[3]} {b[0].time()}-{b[1].time()}')
print('unfinished:', [(x[2], x[3]) for x in iv if not x[1]])
```

```
import re, sys
# usage: pairdiff.py <head screen> <earlier screen>...  -- pairs (by declaration names) in the head screen absent from
# every earlier screen, and pairs in earlier screens absent from the head.
P = re.compile(r'^\s+(\S+::\S+)\s+reproduces\s+(\S+::\S+): (\d+)/(\d+) = (\d+)%')
def pairs(p):
    d = {}
    for l in open(p, encoding='utf-8'):
        m = P.match(l)
        if m: d[(m.group(1), m.group(2))] = l.strip()
    return d
head = pairs(sys.argv[1]); earlier = {}
for p in sys.argv[2:]: earlier.update(pairs(p))
new = [head[k] for k in head if k not in earlier]
gone = [earlier[k] for k in earlier if k not in head]
print(f'head pairs {len(head)}; union of earlier {len(earlier)}; new at head {len(new)}; earlier-only {len(gone)}')
for l in new: print('  NEW  ', l)
for l in gone: print('  GONE ', l)
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/privstmt.py =====

```
import re, sys
KW = r'(theorem|lemma|def|abbrev|instance|structure|inductive|class)'
DECL = re.compile(r'^(@\[[^\]]*\]\s*)*((private|protected|noncomputable|nonrec|partial|unsafe)\s+)*' + KW + r'\s+([^\s(:{\[]+)')
# v3 (gate 69 round 2 and gate 71, minor 1): anonymous instances are declarations too; they
# were skipped and their text absorbed into the previous chunk. Each is keyed by its statement.
ANON = re.compile(r'^(@\[[^\]]*\]\s*)*((private|protected|noncomputable|nonrec|partial|unsafe)\s+)*instance(?=\s*[(:{\[]|\s*$)')
STOP = re.compile(r'^(end\b|namespace\b|section\b|/-!|open\b|variable\b|set_option\b|#|attribute\b|universe\b)')
def chunks(text):
    lines = text.split('\n'); out = []; pend = None; cur = None; depth = 0
    def close(i):
        nonlocal cur
        if cur:
            text = '\n'.join(lines[cur[2]:i]).rstrip()
            name = cur[0]
            if name is None:
                body = text.split('-/', 1)[1] if text.startswith('/--') else text
                name = 'instance⟨' + ' '.join(re.split(r':=', body, maxsplit=1)[0].split()) + '⟩'
                while any(n == name for n, _, _ in out): name += "'"
            out.append((name, cur[1], text))
        cur = None
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        # v2 (B5b gate, minor 5): a line that starts inside a block comment or docstring is never
        # a declaration or a stop line (a docstring line "instance of ..." was counted as one).
        start_depth, j = depth, 0
        while j < len(l):
            if l.startswith('/-', j): depth += 1; j += 2; continue
            if l.startswith('-/', j) and depth > 0: depth -= 1; j += 2; continue
            if depth == 0 and l.startswith('--', j): break
            j += 1
        if start_depth > 0: continue
        if l.startswith('/--'):
            close(i); pend = i; continue
        m = DECL.match(l)
        if m:
            if pend is None: close(i)
            start = pend if pend is not None else i; pend = None
            cur = (m.group(5), l.lstrip().startswith('private') or ' private ' in l.split(m.group(4))[0], start)
            continue
        m = ANON.match(l)
        if m:
            if pend is None: close(i)
            start = pend if pend is not None else i; pend = None
            cur = (None, l.lstrip().startswith('private'), start)
            continue
        if STOP.match(l):
            close(i); pend = None
    close(len(lines))
    return out
def stmt(t):
    body = t.split('-/', 1)[1] if t.startswith('/--') else t
    s = re.split(r':=', body, maxsplit=1)[0]
    return ' '.join(s.split())
# usage: privstmt.py <before> <after>: for declarations (public or private) present in both, report statement
# changes, and those whose text changed outside the statement (body or docstring). Rewritten 2026-10-17 on
# declfreeze.py's parser (the original was lost to the /tmp cleaner); output format as before.
a = chunks(open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read()); b = chunks(open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8').read())
A = {n: t for n, p, t in a}; B = {n: t for n, p, t in b}
both = sorted(set(A) & set(B))
print(f'declarations before/after: {len(A)} {len(B)} | removed: {sorted(set(A) - set(B))}')
print('STATEMENT CHANGED:', [n for n in both if stmt(A[n]) != stmt(B[n])])
other = [n for n in both if stmt(A[n]) == stmt(B[n]) and A[n] != B[n]]
print(f'body/docstring-only changes: {len(other)} {other}')
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/probescan.py =====

```
"""Classify every non-blank, non-comment line of a probe file by its leading command (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I probescan.py <file>..."""
import re, sys
from collections import Counter
for f in sys.argv[1:]:
    c = Counter(); odd = []
    depth = 0
    for n, l in enumerate(open(f, encoding='utf-8'), 1):
        s = l.strip()
        if depth or s.startswith('/-'):
            depth += s.count('/-') - s.count('-/')
            if depth < 0: depth = 0
            continue
        if not s or s.startswith('--'): continue
        m = re.match(r'(import|#check|#print|open|set_option|namespace|end|section|attribute|example)\b', s)
        if m: c[m.group(1)] += 1
        else: c['other'] += 1; odd.append((n, s[:100]))
    bad = [o for o in odd if re.search(r'#eval|run_cmd|run_elab|run_meta|elab|macro|IO\.|initialize|unsafe|extern', o[1])]
    print(f, dict(c), 'risky:', bad, 'other lines:', len(odd))
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/refgrep.sh =====

#!/bin/bash
# Grep every local and remote ref's TCSlib tree for an nf_/Nf declaration name or an nf_ identifier after whitespace, a bracket, a comma or a dot (outside NDNormalForm) and the
# rule-11 names in the delivery's added lines.  usage: refgrep.sh <head.lean> <base.lean>
G=/Users/seyoonr/phd_experiments/tcslib
refs=$(git -C $G for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/heads refs/remotes refs/deliv refs/pull 2>/dev/null)
n=0; hits=0
for r in $refs; do
  n=$((n+1))
  out=$(git -C $G grep -l -E '(theorem|def|abbrev|lemma|instance|structure|inductive|class)[[:space:]]+(nf_|Nf[A-Z])|[[:space:](\[,.]nf_[a-z]' "$r" -- 'TCSlib/*.lean' 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'NDNormalForm.lean')
  if [ -n "$out" ]; then hits=$((hits+1)); echo "HIT $r: $out"; fi
done
echo "refs searched: $n; refs with an nf_/Nf name outside NDNormalForm: $hits"
echo "## rule 11: added lines naming an R3 row or a named foreign private family"
diff <(cat "$2") <(cat "$1") | grep '^>' | grep -nE 'copyTM_run\b|transferTM_run\b|clearTM_run\b|compareTM_run\b|incrementTM_run_succ|incrementTM_run_overflow|xr_|gr_[a-z]|wr_[a-z]|choiceCore|recordStep_runFrom_one|zr_' || echo "none"

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/regions.py =====

```
"""Hunks of base -> head (base line numbers), widths and hygiene of the added lines (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I regions.py <base file> <head file>"""
import difflib, re, sys
A = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n'); B = open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(a=A, b=B, autojunk=False)
added = []
print('## hunks (base lines a1-a2 -> head lines b1-b2)')
for tag, a1, a2, b1, b2 in sm.get_opcodes():
    if tag == 'equal': continue
    print(f'{tag}: base {a1+1}-{a2} ({a2-a1} lines) -> head {b1+1}-{b2} ({b2-b1} lines)')
    for l in A[a1:a2]: print('   -', l)
    for i in range(b1, b2):
        added.append((i + 1, B[i]))
        if b2 - b1 <= 12: print('   +', B[i])
print(f'## added lines: {len(added)}; widest (characters): {max(len(l) for _, l in added)}')
over = [(n, len(l)) for n, l in added if len(l) > 100]
print('added lines over 100 characters:', over)
print('whole-file lines over 100 characters, base:', sum(len(l) > 100 for l in A), '; head:', sum(len(l) > 100 for l in B))
code = []
depth = 0
for n, l in added:
    s = ''; j = 0
    while j < len(l):
        if l.startswith('/-', j): depth += 1; j += 2; continue
        if l.startswith('-/', j) and depth: depth -= 1; j += 2; continue
        if not depth and l.startswith('--', j): break
        if not depth: s += l[j]
        j += 1
    if s.strip(): code.append((n, s))
print(f'## added code lines (comments and docstrings stripped): {len(code)}')
for tok in ['sorry', 'admit', 'axiom', 'unfold', 'delta', 'set_option', 'open', 'section', 'variable',
            'attribute', 'instance', 'native_decide', 'simp_all', 'aesop', 'norm_num', 'decide', 'rfl',
            'show', 'change', 'convert', 'nlinarith', 'omega', 'Classical', 'noncomputable', 'def']:
    hits = [n for n, s in code if re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_.])' + tok + r'(?![A-Za-z0-9_])', s)]
    if hits: print(f'  {tok}: {len(hits)} lines {hits}')
unres = [(n, s.strip()) for n, s in code if re.search(r'\bsimpa?\b(?!\s+only)(?!\?)', s)]
print('unrestricted simp/simpa:', unres)
blank_runs = [n for (n, l), (m, k) in zip(added, added[1:]) if not l.strip() and not k.strip() and m == n + 1]
print('consecutive blank added lines at head lines:', blank_runs)
```

section
local instance nfReviewDecEq (N : FinNDTM Bool) : DecidableEq (nf_SweepState N) := inferInstance
local instance nfReviewFintype (N : FinNDTM Bool) : Fintype (nf_SweepState N) := inferInstance

    (scanTM 2 0 (scanFold (nf_sweepStep N)) scanKeep (nf_sweepInit N)) qe acc rej

          false (scanTM 2 0 (scanFold (nf_sweepStep N)) scanKeep (nf_sweepInit N)) qe acc rej).runWith

              (nf_ctlStop N.k) false (scanTM 2 0 (scanFold (nf_sweepStep N)) scanKeep
                (nf_sweepInit N)) qe acc rej).initCfg x)).state = none ∧
        ((guessCtlRunTM P () 0 ((0 : Fin (2 * N.k + 4)), false) (nf_ctlStep N.k) (nf_ctlStop N.k)

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/sealsum.py =====

```
"""Summarize the review's maximal seal runs (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I sealsum.py <sealed .out> <unsealed .out> <alldefs> <reached defs file>"""
import re, sys
S = open(sys.argv[1], encoding='utf-8').read(); U = open(sys.argv[2], encoding='utf-8').read()
alld = [l.strip() for l in open(sys.argv[3], encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()]
reached = [l.strip() for l in open(sys.argv[4], encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()]
def res(T):
    d = {}
    for m in re.finditer(r'CONTROL_(PASS|FAIL) (\w+) (\S+)', T): d[(m.group(2), m.group(3))] = m.group(1)
    return d
s, u = res(S), res(U)
print('sealed: errors', len(re.findall(r': error', S)), '; warnings', re.findall(r':(\d+):\d+: warning: (.*)', S))
print('unsealed: errors', len(re.findall(r': error', U)), '; warnings', re.findall(r':(\d+):\d+: warning: (.*)', U))
for k in ['rfl', 'eqn', 'simp']:
    ks = [n for (kk, n) in s if kk == k]
    print(f'{k}: {len(ks)} controls; sealed FAIL {sum(s[(k, n)] == "FAIL" for n in ks)}; sealed PASS {sum(s[(k, n)] == "PASS" for n in ks)}; unsealed PASS {sum(u.get((k, n)) == "PASS" for n in ks)}')
good = {}
for (k, n), v in s.items():
    if v == 'FAIL' and u.get((k, n)) == 'PASS': good.setdefault(n, []).append(k)
print('sealed definitions with a control that fails sealed and closes unsealed:', sum(d in good for d in alld), 'of', len(alld))
print('  without one:', [d for d in alld if d not in good])
print('rfl controls failing unsealed (covered by eqn controls):', sorted(n for (k, n) in u if k == 'rfl' and u[(k, n)] == 'FAIL'))
print('  their eqn controls (unsealed / sealed):', [(n, u.get(('eqn', n)), s.get(('eqn', n))) for (k, n) in u if k == 'rfl' and u[(k, n)] == 'FAIL'])
print('eqn controls passing unsealed (recursive definitions):', sorted(n for (k, n) in u if k == 'eqn' and u[(k, n)] == 'PASS'))
print('simp erasure controls:', [(n, u.get(('simp', n)), s.get(('simp', n))) for (k, n) in s if k == 'simp'])
print('reached definitions (the walk, other-file TCSlib):', len(reached), '; each sealed with a working control:', all(r in good for r in reached))
print('  missing:', [r for r in reached if r not in good])
```

/-! ## Review spot checks (appended by the reviewer; not part of the module) -/

-- S1: the sweep state and the host's controller are finite with decidable equality, as the
-- host's `CtlState` instances and the scan phase require
example (N : FinNDTM Bool) : Fintype (nf_SweepState N) := inferInstance
example (N : FinNDTM Bool) : DecidableEq (nf_SweepState N) := inferInstance
example (N : FinNDTM Bool) : Fintype (ScanPhase (nf_SweepState N)) := inferInstance
-- (at the default `synthInstance.maxSize` 128 this one fails to synthesize: out/11b)
set_option synthInstance.maxSize 1024 in
example (N : FinNDTM Bool) : DecidableEq (ScanPhase (nf_SweepState N)) := inferInstance
example (k : ℕ) : Fintype (Fin (2 * k + 4) × Bool) := inferInstance
example (k : ℕ) : DecidableEq (Fin (2 * k + 4) × Bool) := inferInstance

-- S2: `nf_firstStop_records`' hypotheses hold for a one-record stream (k = 0, W = 4) ...
example : (∀ i < 4, nf_ctlStop 0
      (([false, true, true, true].take i).foldl (nf_ctlStep 0) (0, false)) = false) ∧
    nf_ctlStop 0 ([false, true, true, true].foldl (nf_ctlStep 0) (0, false)) = true := by
  decide
-- ... and for a two-record stream (k = 1, W = 6), only the last flagged
example : (∀ i < 12, nf_ctlStop 1 (([true, false, false, true, false, false,
      false, true, true, true, false, true].take i).foldl (nf_ctlStep 1) (0, false)) = false) ∧
    nf_ctlStop 1 ([true, false, false, true, false, false,
      false, true, true, true, false, true].foldl (nf_ctlStep 1) (0, false)) = true := by
  decide
-- S3: a first record carrying the end flag stops the controller early (the stream is not
-- "first stopped at its end")
example : nf_ctlStop 1 (([true, false, false, true, false, true,
      false, true, true, true, false, true].take 6).foldl (nf_ctlStep 1) (0, false)) = true := by
  decide
-- S4: an incomplete record never stops the controller, even with a true last bit
example : nf_ctlStop 1 ([true, false, false, true, true].foldl (nf_ctlStep 1) (0, false)) = false := by
  decide

-- S5: the unused code `01` decodes to blank (presence false, value true), as `00` does
example : nf_decode 0 (fun p => if p.val = 2 then some true else some false) 0 = none := by decide
example : nf_decode 0 (fun _ => some false) 0 = none := by decide
example : nf_decode 0 (fun p => if p.val = 1 then some true else some false) 0 = some false := by
  decide
example : nf_decode 0 (fun _ => some true) 0 = some true := by decide

-- S6: `nf_sweep_display_pass` is not vacuous: a toy machine (no work tape, one state) that halts
-- at its first step emitting `true` meets its three hypotheses on the one-bit word
def nfToyN : FinNDTM Bool where
  k := 0
  State := Unit
  tm := ⟨(), fun _ _ _ _ => ⟨0, fun i => i.elim0, some true, none⟩⟩

example (x : List Bool) :
    nf_sweepPass nfToyN
      ((nf_display nfToyN x [false]).foldl (nf_sweepStep nfToyN) (nf_sweepInit nfToyN)) = true := by
  have hinit : (nfToyN.tm.initCfg x).state = some () := by
    rw [NDTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_state]; rfl
  refine nf_sweep_display_pass nfToyN x [false] ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro r hr
    have : r = 0 := by simp at hr; omega
    subst this
    rw [List.take_zero, NDTM.runWith_nil, hinit]
    simp
  · rw [NDTM.runWith_cons, NDTM.runWith_nil, NDTM.stepWith_of_some hinit, Action.apply_state]
    rfl
  · rw [NDTM.runWith_cons, NDTM.runWith_nil, NDTM.stepWith_of_some hinit, Action.apply_output,
      NDTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_output]
    rfl

-- S7: the display of that run is exactly one record, `false`, blank input read `00`... the
-- input is read at the input head; on `x = []` the read is the right blank
example : nf_display nfToyN [] [false] = [false, false, false, true] := by
  decide

-- S8: a stream whose claim is wrong still runs sweep 0 to its verdict (totality of the scan):
-- the run lemma holds for every stream, so `nf_sweep_run` applies to any `s`
example (x s : List Bool) :=
  (nf_sweep_run nfToyN x s).1

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/stmtcheck.py =====

```
import sys
# usage: stmtcheck.py <earlier> <later>: every comment-stripped code line of <earlier>, except the
# `sorry` proof lines, appears in <later> in order (with `:= sorry` read as the start of a proof).
def strip(src):
    out, i, depth = [], 0, 0
    while i < len(src):
        if src.startswith('/-', i): depth += 1; i += 2; continue
        if src.startswith('-/', i) and depth > 0: depth -= 1; i += 2; continue
        if depth == 0: out.append(src[i])
        i += 1
    return [l.split('--')[0].rstrip() for l in ''.join(out).split('\n') if l.split('--')[0].strip()]
a, b = (strip(open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()) for p in sys.argv[1:3])
j, miss = 0, []
for l in a:
    if l.strip() in ('run := sorry', 'exit_mem := sorry', 'cut := sorry', 'env := sorry'): continue
    probe = l[:-len('sorry')].rstrip() if l.endswith(':= sorry') else l
    k = next((t for t in range(j, len(b)) if b[t] == probe or (probe.endswith(':=') and b[t].startswith(probe))), None)
    if k is None: miss.append(l)
    else: j = k + 1
print(f'{sys.argv[1]} -> {sys.argv[2]}: {len(a)} code lines, {len(miss)} not found in order')
for m in miss: print('   MISSING:', m)
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/sumscheck.py =====

```
"""Verify a SHA256SUMS file against a directory; list files present but not listed (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I sumscheck.py <root>"""
import hashlib, os, sys
root = sys.argv[1]
listed = {}
for l in open(os.path.join(root, 'SHA256SUMS'), encoding='utf-8'):
    l = l.rstrip('\n')
    if not l.strip(): continue
    h, p = l.split(None, 1); p = os.path.normpath(p.lstrip('*'))
    listed[p] = h
ok = bad = missing = 0; bads = []
for p, h in listed.items():
    fp = os.path.join(root, p)
    if not os.path.exists(fp): missing += 1; bads.append('MISSING ' + p); continue
    if hashlib.sha256(open(fp, 'rb').read()).hexdigest() == h: ok += 1
    else: bad += 1; bads.append('BAD ' + p)
present = set()
for dp, dn, fn in os.walk(root):
    for f in fn: present.add(os.path.relpath(os.path.join(dp, f), root))
unlisted = sorted(present - set(listed) - {'SHA256SUMS'})
print(f'entries {len(listed)} ok {ok} bad {bad} missing {missing}')
for b in bads: print(' ', b)
print('unlisted files:', unlisted)
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/tacargs.py =====

```
"""Tactic-argument identifiers of head lines [a, b] (comments stripped), as (kind, identifier,
line) rows (python3 -I).  Bracketed lists of rw/rwa/simp/simp only/simpa/simpa only/dsimp/
dsimp only/simp_rw/nth_rw/simp_all/norm_num/field_simp (nested brackets balanced), unfold/delta
targets, and every identifier in show/change terms (to the end of the line).
usage: python3 -I tacargs2.py <file> <a> <b> <out tsv> <out ids>"""
import re, sys
f, a, b, outp, idsp = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]), sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5]
L = open(f, encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
# strip comments, keeping newlines (to keep line numbers)
src = '\n'.join(L[a - 1:b]); out, i, depth = [], 0, 0
while i < len(src):
    if src.startswith('/-', i): depth += 1; i += 2; continue
    if src.startswith('-/', i) and depth: depth -= 1; i += 2; continue
    if not depth and src.startswith('--', i):
        j = src.find('\n', i); i = len(src) if j < 0 else j; continue
    out.append(src[i] if not depth or src[i] == '\n' else ' '); i += 1
code = ''.join(out)
def line_of(pos): return a + code.count('\n', 0, pos)
ID = re.compile(r"(?<![\w.'₀-₉])(?:←\s*)?([A-Za-z_][\w.'₀-₉!?]*)")
KW = {'fun', 'by', 'at', 'with', 'using', 'if', 'then', 'else', 'this', 'only', 'in', 'from', 'let',
      'show', 'have', 'exact', 'rfl', 'decide', 'omega', 'simp', 'Type', 'Prop', 'true', 'false',
      'match', 'do', 'return', 'calc', 'and', 'or', 'not', 'at', 'if', 'h'}
rows = []
TAC = re.compile(r'\b(rwa|rw|simp_rw|nth_rw\s+\d+|simpa only|simpa|simp_all only|simp_all|simp only|simp|dsimp only|dsimp|norm_num|field_simp)\b(\s*\[)?')
for m in TAC.finditer(code):
    kind = re.sub(r'\s+\d+', '', m.group(1))
    if not m.group(2):
        rows.append((kind + ' (no list)', '-', line_of(m.start()))); continue
    j = m.end(); d = 1
    while j < len(code) and d:
        if code[j] == '[': d += 1
        elif code[j] == ']': d -= 1
        j += 1
    lst = code[m.end():j - 1]
    for x in ID.finditer(lst):
        if x.group(1) not in KW: rows.append((kind, x.group(1), line_of(m.end() + x.start())))
for m in re.finditer(r'\b(unfold|delta)\b([^\n;)⟩]*)', code):
    for x in ID.finditer(m.group(2)):
        if x.group(1) not in KW: rows.append((m.group(1), x.group(1), line_of(m.start())))
for m in re.finditer(r'\b(show|change)\b([^\n]*)', code):
    for x in ID.finditer(m.group(2)):
        if x.group(1) not in KW: rows.append((m.group(1) + ' term', x.group(1), line_of(m.start())))
with open(outp, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as o:
    for k, x, ln in rows: o.write(f'{k}\t{x}\t{ln}\n')
ids = sorted({x for _, x, _ in rows if x != '-'})
open(idsp, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(ids) + '\n')
from collections import Counter
c = Counter(k for k, _, _ in rows)
print('rows', len(rows), 'distinct identifiers', len(ids))
for k, v in sorted(c.items()): print(f'  {k}: {v}')
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/targetcmp.py =====

```
"""Compare the target's code (after its docstring) and docstring at base and head (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I targetcmp.py <base> <head> <decl line prefix>"""
import sys, difflib
def split(path, key):
    L = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
    i = next(k for k, l in enumerate(L) if l.startswith(key))
    j = i
    while not L[j].startswith('/--'): j -= 1
    e = i
    while e < len(L) and L[e].strip() != '': e += 1
    return L[j:i], L[i:e], (j + 1, i + 1, e)
for nm, p in (('base', sys.argv[1]), ('head', sys.argv[2])):
    d, c, pos = split(p, sys.argv[3]); print(f'{nm}: docstring lines {pos[0]}-{pos[1]-1}, code lines {pos[1]}-{pos[2]}')
db, cb, _ = split(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[3]); dh, ch, _ = split(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])
print('code (statement + body) byte-identical:', cb == ch)
for l in cb: print('   |', l)
print('## docstring diff')
for l in difflib.unified_diff(db, dh, 'base', 'head', lineterm='', n=0): print(l)
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/tiles.py =====

```
"""Show the shared tiles behind a copy-screen pair (the v3 screen's own extraction and tiling,
copied from scripts/copy-text-screen-v3.py; python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I tiles.py <root> <target file> <target decl> <source file> <source decl>"""
import re, sys
root, fa, da, fb, db = sys.argv[1:6]
def strip(src):
    out = []; i = 0; depth = 0; n = len(src)
    while i < n:
        if src.startswith('/-', i): depth += 1; i += 2; continue
        if depth and src.startswith('-/', i): depth -= 1; i += 2; continue
        if depth: i += 1; continue
        if src.startswith('--', i):
            j = src.find('\n', i); i = n if j < 0 else j; continue
        out.append(src[i]); i += 1
    return ''.join(out)
DECL = re.compile(r"^(?:@\[[^\]]*\]\s*)?((?:(?:noncomputable|private|protected)\s+)*)"
                  r"(def|theorem|lemma|abbrev|instance|structure|inductive)\s+(\S+)", re.M)
def body(b):
    d = 0
    for i, ch in enumerate(b):
        if ch in '([{⟨': d += 1
        elif ch in ')]}⟩': d -= 1
        elif b.startswith(':=', i) and d == 0: return b[i + 2:]
    return ''
def lcs(a, b):
    lo, hi, best = 0, min(len(a), len(b)), ''
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi + 1) // 2
        subs = {b[i:i + mid] for i in range(len(b) - mid + 1)}
        hit = next((a[i:i + mid] for i in range(len(a) - mid + 1) if a[i:i + mid] in subs), None)
        if hit is not None: lo, best = mid, hit
        else: hi = mid - 1
    return lo, best
def get(f, name):
    t = strip(open(f'{root}/{f}', encoding='utf-8').read()); ms = list(DECL.finditer(t))
    for i, m in enumerate(ms):
        if m.group(3) == name:
            end = ms[i + 1].start() if i + 1 < len(ms) else len(t)
            return re.sub(r'\s+', '', body(t[m.start():end]))
    raise SystemExit('not found ' + name)
ta, tb = get(fa, da), get(fb, db)
a, b, c, tiles = ta, tb, 0, []
while True:
    n, seg = lcs(b, a)
    if n < 25: break
    c += n; tiles.append(seg); a = a.replace(seg, '\x00', 1); b = b.replace(seg, '\x01', 1)
print(f'{da} ({len(ta)} chars) reproduces {db} ({len(tb)} chars): {c}/{len(tb)} = {c/len(tb):.0%}')
print(f'  source body: {tb}')
for s in tiles: print(f'  tile {len(s)}: {s}')
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/transcmp.py =====

```
"""Compare a head declaration's code with a probe declaration's, after renaming (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I transcmp.py <head> <decl> <probe> <probe decl> [old=new ...]"""
import re, sys, difflib
def get(path, name):
    L = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read().split('\n')
    i = next(k for k, l in enumerate(L) if re.match(r'^(private )?(theorem|def) ' + re.escape(name) + r'\b', l))
    j = i + 1
    while j < len(L) and L[j].strip() and not L[j].startswith('/--') and not re.match(r'^(private )?(theorem|def|end|section|#)', L[j]): j += 1
    return L[i:j]
a = get(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]); b = get(sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4])
for sub in sys.argv[5:]:
    o, n = sub.split('=', 1); b = [l.replace(o, n) for l in b]
a = [l.replace('private ', '', 1) if k == 0 else l for k, l in enumerate(a)]
print(f'{sys.argv[2]} ({len(a)} lines) vs {sys.argv[4]} ({len(b)} lines), renamed {sys.argv[5:]}: identical={a == b}')
for l in difflib.unified_diff(b, a, sys.argv[4], sys.argv[2], lineterm='', n=0): print('  ', l)
```

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/users_tail.lean.txt =====


open NFAudit in
/-- Local constants using a given constant directly, and imported TCSlib theorems among the
direct externals whose statements mention it. -/
elab "#nf_users " id:ident : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let n := id.getId
  let mut out : Array String := #[]
  for (c, ci) in env.constants.map₂.toList do
    if ci.getUsedConstantsAsSet.contains n then out := out.push s!"{pub c}"
  out := out.qsort (· < ·)
  logInfo m!"USERS of {n} ({out.size}): {out}"

open NFAudit in
/-- Direct TCSlib theorems of the new code whose statement mentions a given constant. -/
elab "#nf_stmt_mentions " id:ident : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let n := id.getId
  let mut ext : NameSet := {}
  for (_, ci) in env.constants.map₂.toList do
    for d in ci.getUsedConstantsAsSet.toList do
      if isTCSlib env d then ext := ext.insert d
  let mut out : Array String := #[]
  for d in ext.toList do
    if (typeConsts env d).contains n then out := out.push s!"{d}"
  out := out.qsort (· < ·)
  logInfo m!"DIRECT TCSlib constants whose type mentions {n} ({out.size}): {out}"

## ===== campaign/fills/c1/reviews/nf-fill/scripts/ziplist.py =====

```
"""List a zip's members with sizes, timestamps, and flags unsafe paths/symlinks (python3 -I).
usage: python3 -I ziplist.py <zip>"""
import sys, zipfile, stat
z = zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1])
bad = []
for i in z.infolist():
    mode = (i.external_attr >> 16) & 0o177777
    link = stat.S_ISLNK(mode)
    n = i.filename
    unsafe = n.startswith('/') or '..' in n.split('/') or link
    if unsafe: bad.append(n)
    print(f"{'%04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d' % i.date_time} {i.file_size:>9} {'LINK ' if link else ''}{n}")
print('members', len(z.infolist()), 'unsafe', bad)
```

import TCSlib.Complexity.ClassNP.NTIME

set_option maxHeartbeats 0
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option autoImplicit false

/-!
# The linear-overhead coded normal form of an NDTM

[AB09, §3.2] ([BGW70]-style guess-then-verify): every bundled binary nondeterministic machine has a
coded two-work-tape equivalent (`Turing.CodeNDTM`) whose acceptance tracks the original's at linear
time overhead, forward with an explicit constant and backward in unbounded form. The
nondeterministic time hierarchy (`TCSlib.Complexity.Diagonalization.NTimeHierarchy`) diagonalizes
over these codes. This module isolates the normal-form statement and its supporting construction.

## Main definitions

No new definitions: the normal form is an existential contract.

## Main results

* `Turing.FinNDTM.exists_codeNDTM_accepts_linear` — the linear-overhead coded normal form.

## References

* [AB09] S. Arora, B. Barak, *Computational Complexity: A Modern Approach*,
  Cambridge University Press, 2009. (§3.2.)
* [BGW70] R. Book, S. Greibach, B. Wegbreit, *Time- and tape-bounded Turing
  acceptors and AFLs*, JCSS 4(6), 1970. (Cited through [AB09]; no external text is required.)
-/

namespace Turing

namespace FinNDTM

/-- A finite-state machine with two binary work tapes has a code with identical acceptance.

**Proof sketch.** Relabel the finite state type by its equivalence with a finite ordinal.
Read the initial configuration and the relabeled run through their field equations, and
transfer halting and the exact output word in both directions. -/
private theorem nf_pack {S : Type} [Fintype S] (H : NDTM 2 Bool S) :
    ∃ M : CodeNDTM, ∀ (x : List Bool) (t : ℕ), M.toFinNDTM.AcceptsWithin x t ↔
      ∃ w : List Bool, w.length = t ∧ (H.runWith w (H.initCfg x)).state = none ∧
        (H.runWith w (H.initCfg x)).output = [true] := by
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card S := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨H.q₀⟩
  let e : S ≃ Fin (Fintype.card S - 1 + 1) :=
    (Fintype.equivFin S).trans (finCongr (by omega))
  refine ⟨⟨Fintype.card S - 1, H.relabelState e⟩, fun x t => ?_⟩
  rw [FinNDTM.acceptsWithin_iff]
  simp only [CodeNDTM.toFinNDTM_tm, CodeNDTM.toFinNDTM_k, CodeNDTM.toFinNDTM_State]
  have hinit : (H.relabelState e).initCfg x = (H.initCfg x).mapState e := by
    rw [NDTM.initCfg_eq, NDTM.initCfg_eq, NDTM.relabelState_q₀]
    apply Cfg.ext
    · rw [Cfg.init_state, Cfg.mapState_state, Cfg.init_state]; rfl
    · rw [Cfg.init_inputPos, Cfg.mapState_inputPos, Cfg.init_inputPos]
    · funext i p; rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapes, Cfg.init_workTapes, Cfg.init_workTapes]
    · funext i; rw [Cfg.mapState_workTapePos, Cfg.init_workTapePos, Cfg.init_workTapePos]
    · rw [Cfg.mapState_output, Cfg.init_output, Cfg.init_output]
  rw [hinit]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hh, ho⟩
    refine ⟨w, hw, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [NDTM.relabelState_runWith, Cfg.mapState_state] at hh
      exact Option.map_eq_none_iff.mp hh
    · rwa [NDTM.relabelState_runWith, Cfg.mapState_output] at ho
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hh, ho⟩
    refine ⟨w, hw, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [NDTM.relabelState_runWith, Cfg.mapState_state, hh]; rfl
    · rwa [NDTM.relabelState_runWith, Cfg.mapState_output]

/-- The trivial setup: a machine started at its exit meets `Turing.guessCtlRunTM`'s setup
hypotheses at time `0`, on every tape. -/
private theorem nf_setup {SP : Type} (P : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool SP) (z : List Bool) (j : Fin 2) :
    P.runFrom (P.initCfg z) 0 = P.initCfg z ∧ (P.initCfg z).state = some P.q₀ ∧
      (∀ u < 0, (P.runFrom (P.initCfg z) u).state ≠ some P.q₀) ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, (P.initCfg z).workTapes j ((P.initCfg z).workTapePos j + p) = none) ∧
      (P.initCfg z).workTapes j ((P.initCfg z).workTapePos j - 1) = none := by
  refine ⟨MultiTapeTM.runFrom_zero, ?_, fun u hu => absurd hu (Nat.not_lt_zero u), fun p => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_state]
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_workTapes]
  · rw [MultiTapeTM.initCfg_eq, Cfg.init_workTapes]

/-- The display controller records the next position and the last completed record's flag. -/
private def nf_ctlStep (k : ℕ) (q : Fin (2 * k + 4) × Bool) (b : Bool) :
    Fin (2 * k + 4) × Bool :=
  if h : q.1.val = 2 * k + 3 then (0, b)
  else (⟨q.1.val + 1, by have := q.1.isLt; omega⟩, q.2)

/-- The controller stops precisely at a record boundary carrying a true end flag. -/
private def nf_ctlStop (k : ℕ) (q : Fin (2 * k + 4) × Bool) : Bool :=
  decide (q.1.val = 0) && q.2

/-- Starting at a record boundary, the position is the length read modulo the record width.

**Proof sketch.** Induct by appending one bit. At the last position the controller resets;
otherwise it advances by one. These are exactly the two cases of addition modulo the width. -/
private theorem nf_ctl_position (k : ℕ) (s : List Bool) (f : Bool) :
    (s.foldl (nf_ctlStep k) (0, f)).1.val = s.length % (2 * k + 4) := by
  induction s using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.foldl_nil, List.length_nil, Nat.zero_mod]
    rfl
  | append_singleton s b ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil,
      List.length_append, List.length_singleton]
    rw [nf_ctlStep]
    split_ifs with h
    · have hm : s.length % (2 * k + 4) = 2 * k + 3 := by omega
      rw [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show 1 < 2 * k + 4 by omega), hm]
      have he : 2 * k + 3 + 1 = 2 * k + 4 := by omega
      simp only [he, Nat.mod_self, Fin.val_zero]
    · have hp := (s.foldl (nf_ctlStep k) (0, f)).1.isLt
      have hm : s.length % (2 * k + 4) + 1 < 2 * k + 4 := by omega
      rw [Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show 1 < 2 * k + 4 by omega),
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm]
      exact congrArg (fun n => n + 1) ih

/-- A nonempty prefix stops exactly when its length is a whole number of records and its
last bit is true.

**Proof sketch.** Separate the empty prefix and a prefix obtained by appending one bit.
The last position resets to zero and records that bit; every other position is nonzero. -/
private theorem nf_ctl_stop_iff (k : ℕ) (s : List Bool) :
    nf_ctlStop k (s.foldl (nf_ctlStep k) (0, false)) = true ↔
      s ≠ [] ∧ s.length % (2 * k + 4) = 0 ∧ s.getLastD false = true := by
  induction s using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => simp [nf_ctlStop]
  | append_singleton s b _ =>
    have hp := nf_ctl_position k (s ++ [b]) false
    rw [List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil, nf_ctlStep] at hp ⊢
    split_ifs at hp ⊢ with h
    · have hz : (s ++ [b]).length % (2 * k + 4) = 0 := hp.symm
      have hz' : (s.length + 1) % (2 * k + 4) = 0 := by
        simpa only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] using hz
      simp [nf_ctlStop, hz']
    · have hn : (s ++ [b]).length % (2 * k + 4) ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz
        have hp' : (s.foldl (nf_ctlStep k) (0, false)).1.val + 1 =
            (s ++ [b]).length % (2 * k + 4) := hp
        omega
      have hn' : (s.length + 1) % (2 * k + 4) ≠ 0 := by
        simpa only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] using hn
      simp [nf_ctlStop, hn']

/-- A record consists of its choice bit, two bits for each claimed read (input first), and
its end flag. A blank is encoded by `00`, false by `10`, and true by `11`. -/
private def nf_record (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) (reads : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool) (last : Bool)
    (p : Fin (2 * k + 4)) : Bool :=
  if p.val = 0 then b
  else if h : p.val = 2 * k + 3 then last
  else
    let i : Fin (k + 1) := ⟨(p.val - 1) / 2, by have := p.isLt; omega⟩
    if (p.val - 1) % 2 = 0 then (reads i).isSome else (reads i).getD false

/-- The last position of a record is its end flag. -/
private theorem nf_record_last (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) (reads : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool)
    (last : Bool) : nf_record k b reads last ⟨2 * k + 3, by omega⟩ = last := by
  rw [nf_record, if_neg (show 2 * k + 3 ≠ 0 by omega), dif_pos rfl]

/-- The first position of a record is its choice bit. -/
private theorem nf_record_choice (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) (reads : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool)
    (last : Bool) : nf_record k b reads last 0 = b := by
  rw [nf_record, if_pos (show (0 : Fin (2 * k + 4)).val = 0 from rfl)]

/-- Each claimed read occupies its designated presence bit and value bit.

**Proof sketch.** At the two designated offsets the quotient is the claimed-read index.
The remainder distinguishes its presence bit from its value bit. -/
private theorem nf_record_read (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) (reads : Fin (k + 1) → Option Bool)
    (last : Bool) (i : Fin (k + 1)) :
    nf_record k b reads last ⟨2 * i.val + 1, by omega⟩ = (reads i).isSome ∧
      nf_record k b reads last ⟨2 * i.val + 2, by omega⟩ = (reads i).getD false := by
  have hi := i.isLt
  constructor
  · have hq : (2 * i.val + 1 - 1) / 2 = i.val := by omega
    have hr : (2 * i.val + 1 - 1) % 2 = 0 := by omega
    rw [nf_record, if_neg (show 2 * i.val + 1 ≠ 0 by omega),
      dif_neg (show 2 * i.val + 1 ≠ 2 * k + 3 by omega), if_pos hr]
    exact congrArg (fun j => (reads j).isSome) (Fin.ext hq)
  · have hq : (2 * i.val + 2 - 1) / 2 = i.val := by omega
    have hr : (2 * i.val + 2 - 1) % 2 ≠ 0 := by omega
    rw [nf_record, if_neg (show 2 * i.val + 2 ≠ 0 by omega),
      dif_neg (show 2 * i.val + 2 ≠ 2 * k + 3 by omega), if_neg hr]
    exact congrArg (fun j => (reads j).getD false) (Fin.ext hq)

/-- The display of a branch records the reads before each step, the step's choice bit, and
an end flag only on the last record. Actions and machine states are not guessed. -/
private def nf_display (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x w : List Bool) : List Bool :=
  List.ofFn fun i : Fin ((2 * N.k + 4) * w.length) =>
    let r : Fin w.length := ⟨i.val / (2 * N.k + 4),
      (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by omega)).2 (by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using i.isLt)⟩
    let p : Fin (2 * N.k + 4) := ⟨i.val % (2 * N.k + 4), Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩
    let c := N.tm.runWith (w.take r.val) (N.tm.initCfg x)
    nf_record N.k w[r.val] (Fin.cases c.inputSymbol c.workTapeSymbols)
      (decide (r.val + 1 = w.length)) p

/-- A display has exactly `2k + 4` bits per step. -/
private theorem nf_display_length (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x w : List Bool) :
    (nf_display N x w).length = (2 * N.k + 4) * w.length := by
  simp only [nf_display, List.length_ofFn]

/-- The end bit of the `r`th record of a display is true exactly on its last record.

**Proof sketch.** With the width `W = 2k + 4`, the final cell of record `r` has index
`W(r+1)-1`. Its quotient by `W` is `r` and its remainder is `W-1`, so the record encoder returns
the prescribed end flag. -/
private theorem nf_display_flag (N : FinNDTM Bool) (x w : List Bool) (r : Fin w.length) :
    (nf_display N x w)[(2 * N.k + 4) * (r.val + 1) - 1]? =
      some (decide (r.val + 1 = w.length)) := by
  let W := 2 * N.k + 4
  have hW : 0 < W := by omega
  have hprod : 0 < W * (r.val + 1) := Nat.mul_pos hW (by omega)
  have hi : W * (r.val + 1) - 1 < (nf_display N x w).length := by
    rw [nf_display_length]
    have hle := Nat.mul_le_mul_left W (show r.val + 1 ≤ w.length by omega)
    show W * (r.val + 1) - 1 < W * w.length
    omega
  have hd : (W * (r.val + 1) - 1) / W = r.val := by
    simpa only [Nat.zero_add, Nat.zero_div, Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
      Nat.mul_sub_div 0 W (r.val + 1) hprod
  have hm : (W * (r.val + 1) - 1) % W = 2 * N.k + 3 := by
    have he := Nat.mod_add_div (W * (r.val + 1) - 1) W
    rw [hd] at he
    have hdecomp : W * (r.val + 1) = W * r.val + W := by ring
    rw [hdecomp] at he ⊢
    have he' : W = 2 * N.k + 4 := rfl
    omega
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi]
